tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅/ /gup+tar+thaprashākapradz+nyāpāramitepadeshashāsatramabhisamayālaṃkaras+yalak+ṣaṇayedharmāṅgas+phuṭabibhāṣāsti// ༄༅/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi mtshon byed kyi chos rnams kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa sbas don rab gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi mtshon byed kyi chos rnams kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa sbas don rab gsal zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dbyings dang ye shes ro gcig gyur kyang rnam dag dbyings nyid mig gis rig /thabs dang shes rab dbyer med gyur kyang thabs kyis zhi dang shes pas srid mtha' gnon/ /srid dang zhi ba mnyam nyid gyur kyang srid pa'i skyon spangs zhi ba'i yon tan brnyes/ /rgyal ba kun gyi yab gcig gyur kyang rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab kun tu 'dzin la 'dud/ /gang gi mkhyen pa chu thags rdzing bu las byung mngon par rtogs pa pad+mo'i tshal/ /shākya'i rgyal mtshan gsung gi nyin byed 'od kyis rnam phye nges don sbrang rtsi'i bcud/ /bdag blo'i bung bas rnam dpyod mchu yis gzhib ste legs bshad dar dir dang bcas pa/ /don gnyer skye bo'i tshogs la sbyin gyis blo gros ro 'dzin kun tu tshim par mdzod/ /'di la don gsum ste/ brjod bya sher phyin la 'jug pa'i yan lag mchod brjod dang / rjod byed bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag dgos 'brel/ bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs bshad pa'o/ /dang po la dngos dang / 'phros don gnyis las dang po ni/ mchod brjod kyi yul du gyur pa'i yum gyi mtshan nyid/ rang sras 'phags pa skyed byed dang de'i bzhed don sgrub byed gang rung du gyur pa'i bdag med rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa/ de la skyed byed kyi dang / bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum gnyis las/

dang po'i mtshan nyid/ bdag med gsum gang rung rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang gi rtogs pa'i rgyun phyi ma la gnas pa'i sras 'phags pa skyed par byed pa'i mkhyen pa/ de la dbye na rang sras nyan thos 'phags pa/ rang sras rang rgyal 'phags pa/ rang sras byang sems 'phags pa/ rang sras sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i skyed byed kyi yum dang bzhi las dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi gang zag giṃ bdag gi skye med du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang gi rtogs pa'i rgyun phyi ma la gnas pa'i nyan thos 'phags pa skyed par byed pa'i mkhyen pa/ de la dbye na gzhi gang zag gi bdag gi skye med du don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i dang / mngon sum du rtogs pa'i skyed byed kyi yum gnyis las/ snga ma ni nyan thos kyi tshogs sbyor na yod/ phyi ma ni nyan thos kyi mthong lam nas theg chen lam du 'jug kha ma'i snga logs kyi bar na yod/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi gzung ba chos kyi bdag giṃ skye med du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang gi rtogs pa'i rgyun phyi ma la gnas pa'i rang rgyal 'phags pa skyed par byed pa'i mkhyen pa/ dbye ba dang sa mtshams snga ma la dpags te shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ lam 'dzin pa chos kyi bdag giṃ skye med du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang gi rtogs pa'i rgyun phyi ma la gnas pa'i byang sems 'phags pa skyed par byed pa'i mkhyen pa'o/ /dbye na lam skye med du don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i dang / mngon sum du rtogs pa'i skyed byed kyi yum gnyis lasaṃ snga ma ni theg chen gyi tshogs sbyor na yod/ phyi ma ni sa dang po nas rgyun mtha'i snga logs kyi bar na yod do/ /bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang gi rtogs pa'i rgyun phyi ma la gnas pa'i sangs rgyas 'phags pa skyed par byed pa'i mkhyen pa/ dbye na rnam pa skye med du don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa dang /

mngon sum du rtogs pa'i skyed byed kyi yum gnyis las snga ma ni theg chen gyi tshogs sbyor na yod/ phyi ma ni sa dang po nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa bzhed don sgrub byed kyi yum gyi mtshan nyid/ bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud ldan gyi 'phags pa'i bzhed don gyi gtso bo sgrub pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i mkhyen pa/ dbye na mchod brjod kyi yul du gyur pa'i yum gzhi shes/ lam shes/ rnam mkhyen gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi gang zag gi bdag giṃ dang gzung ba chos kyi bdag giṃ skye med gang rung mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud ldan gyi theg dman 'phags pa nyer zhi gnyis su 'khrid par byed pa'i mkhyen pa/ sa mtshams theg dman gyi mthong lam nas theg chen lam du 'jug kha ma'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ lam skye med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud ldan gyi byang sems 'phags pa'i 'jig rten gyi don sgrub par byed pa'i mkhyen pa/ sa mtshams sa dang po nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ rnam pa skye med du mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud ldan gyi sangs rgyas 'phags pas chos 'khor bskor ba'i bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa/ sa mtshams sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nar yod/ gnyis pa 'phros don la gsum ste/ bsdus tshul las 'phros pa/ tshig don las 'phros pa/ brgal lan las 'phros pa'o/ /dang po ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gsum gyis don brgyad bsdus pa'i tshul ji lta bu snyam na/ sdud byed kyi mkhyen gsum ni/ gzhi skye med du rtogs pa dang / lam skye med du rtogs pa dang / rnam pa skye med du rtogs pa tsam yin la/ dang pos theg dman 'phags pa'i mngon par rtogs pa la gzhi shes su bzhag pa de bsdus/ gnyis pas byang sems 'phags pa'i mngon par rtogs pa la lam shes su bzhag pa dang sbyor ba bzhi po bsdus/

gsum pas sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i mngon par rtogs pa la rnam mkhyen du bzhag pa dang 'bras bu chos sku bsdus so/ /nges pa'i don ni gzhan zhig na snang ngo / /gnyis pa la gzhi shes kyi tshig don gyi skabs su dman pa'i myang 'das kyi mtshan nyid/ khams gsum gyi nyon mongs ma lus par spangs pa'i dman pa'i so sor brtags 'gog de la bstan tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na dman pa'i lhag bcas myang 'das dang dman pa'i lhag med myang 'das gnyis las mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ nyon mongs pa'i kun 'byung zad par spangs shing dgra bcom dang por thob pa'i lus rten dang bcas pa'i dang / de dang bral ba'i dman pa'i so sor brtags 'gog theg pa'i sgo nas dbye na nyan thos kyi myang 'das dang / rang rgyal gyi myang 'das gnyis las khams gsum gyi nyon mongs ma lus par spangs pa'i nyan thos kyi rgyud kyi so sor brtags 'gog dang / de ma lus par spangs pa'i rang rgyal gyi rgyud kyi so sor brtags 'gog rnam mkhyen gyi tshig don gyi skabs su chos 'khor gyi mtshan nyid/ lung rtogs gang rung gis bsdus pa'i ston pa'i dam chos/ dbye na lung gi chos 'khor dang / rtogs pa'i chos 'khor gnyis las dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rtogs pa'i chos 'khor brjod byar ston pa'i ston pa'i dam chos/ dbye na bka' dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor sogs gsum yod cing de re re la yang chos 'khor dang po'i dang po sogs gsum gsum yod do/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'gog lam gang rung gis bsdus pa'i bstan pa'i dam chos/ dbye na 'gog lam gnyis las/ dang po la nyan thos kyi 'gog pa/ rang rgyal gyi 'gog pa/ theg chen gyi 'gog pa dang gsum mo/ /phyi ma la theg pa gsum gyi lam lnga gsum bco lnga yod do/ /gsum pa la brgal lan gyi lam shes kyi mdo'i skabs su nyan rang gi spangs rtogs kyi rigs theg chen gyi lam gang du rdzogs pa/ rdzogs smin sbyang gsum gyi tshad/

yang dag mtha' ngos gzung zhing de mngon du byas pa'i tshad dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ nyan rang dgra bcom gyi spangs rtogs kyi rigs byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod nas rdzogs te/ des nyan rang dgra bcom gyis ji tsam spangs pa de spangs/ ji tsam rtogs pa de rtogs pa'i phyir dang / des 'khor bar 'ching byed kyi nyon sgrib ma lus par spangs shing / gang zag gi bdag med dang gzung ba chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa'i dgos pa mthar thug thob pa'i phyir ro/ /nyon yid khas len na 'di'i rnam bzhag byed pa dka'o/ /gnyis pa la/ smon lam rdzogs pa'i tshad ni smon lam gyi gtso bo sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par smon pa de rdzogs pa'o/ /sems can smin par byas pa'i tshad ni/ rang nyid sprul skur sangs rgyas pa'i tshe chos 'khor dang po'i gdul bya'i gtso bo de/ mthong spangs gi sgrib pa dngos su spong rung dang / gnyen po mthong lam dngos su skye rung du byas pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su sbyangs pa'i tshad ni/ rang snang la snod bcud thams cad dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig tu shar ba'o/ /gsum pa la/ yang dag mtha'i ngo bo ni chos nyid de bzhin nyid de/ mdo sde sa bcu pa las bshad pa'i spros pa mtha' dag bkag pa'i 'gog pa dang don gcig go /de mngon du byas pa'i tshad la rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum ma byas par de mngon du byas pa dang / rdzogs smin sbyangs gsum byas te mngon du byas pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dag sar chos nyid de bzhin nyid la rtsol med du yun ring du mnyam par gzhag pas re zhig gzhan don rgyun chad pa'i nyes pa dang bcas pa'o/ /phyi ma ni sangs rgyas kyi sar gzhan don 'bad med lhun grub tu 'byung bzhin du chos nyid la dus rtag tu mnyam par gzhag pa las ma g.yos pa'o/ /gnyis pa rjod byed bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag dgos sogs chos bzhi bshad pa la/

dgos 'brel ngag la yod pa'i dgos sogs chos bzhi bshad pa dang / bstan bcos lus la yod pa'i dgos sogs chos bzhi bshad pa la gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bstan bcos lus kyi dgos sogs chos bzhi po de dgos 'brel ngag gi brjod bya/ dgos 'brel ngag la brten nas rgyan la dgos sogs chos bzhi yod par nges pas/ rgyan la dgos sogs chos bzhi med par 'dzin pa'i dogs pa bsal nas rtse gnyis su 'dzin pa'i the tshom bskyed pa'am rtse gnyis su 'dzin pa'i dogs pa bsal nas don 'gyur gyi the tshom bskyed pa ni dgos 'brel ngag gi dgos pa/ dgos 'brel ngag la brten nas rgyan la dgos sogs chos bzhi yod par nges te/ rgyan la thos sogs kyis 'jug pa ni dgos 'brel ngag gi nying dgos/ de gsum thabs las byung ba'i 'brel pa ni dgos 'brel ngag gi 'brel pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ni/ brjod bya dngos po brgyad don bdun cu rjod byed sher phyin dang bcas pa ni brjod bya/ rgyan la brten nas mdo don bde blag tu rtogs pa ni rgyan gyi dgos pa/ rgyan la brten nas 'bras bu chos sku mngon du byas pa ni rgyan gyi nying dgos/ de gsum thabs las byung ba'i tshul gyis 'brel pa ni rgyan gyi 'brel pa yin no/ /gsum pa bstan bcos kyi brjod bya mngon rtogs bshad pa la gnyis te/ bsdus don lus rnam gzhag dang / tshig don yan lag rgyas bshad do/ /dang po la gnyis te/ lus mdor bstan pa dang / cung zad phye ste bshad pa'o/ /dang po la ji ltar bshad pa'i tshul dang / dngos po brgyad du phye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dngos po brgyad du phye ba'i sher phyin de mngon rtogs brgyad kyi sgo nas bshad pa'o/ /de la sher phyin mtshan nyid pa ni 'bras bu sher phyin yin la/ de'i mtshan nyid ni/ chos rab rnam 'byed kyi blo gang zhig srid zhi'i pha rol tu son pa'o/ /gzhung sher phyin stong phrag brgya pa la sogs pa gzhung gi tshogs rnams so/

/lam sher phyin ni chos rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i shes rab ste/ theg pa chen po'i mthong lam dang sgom lam gyis bsdus pa'o/ /de gnyis ni sher phyin btags pa ba yin te/ 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni gzhung sher phyin ni sher phyin brjod byar ston byed tsam yin pa'i phyir dang / lam sher phyin ni sher phyin 'thob byed yin pa'i phyir ro/ /btags pa'i dgos pa ni/ sher phyin don du gnyer bas gzhung sher phyin la thos sogs kyis 'jug cing / lam sher phyin ni bsgom byar bstan pa'i don du yin no/ /dngos la gnod byed ni/ de gnyis la de'i mtshan nyid ma tshang ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ ci'i phyir sher phyin gyi lus de la dngos po brgyad du grangs nges she na/ don du gnyer bya'i 'bras bu sher phyin de thob pa la/ gtan la dbab par bya ba'i yul gsum/ nyams len sbyor ba bzhi/ thob bya'i 'bras bu chos sku rnams kyis mthar phyin par bya dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /ci'i phyir gtan la dbab par bya ba'i yul la gsum du grangs nges she na/ 'bras bu la spro ba bskyed pa'i ched du rnam mkhyen/ 'thob byed kyi rgyu shes pa'i ched du lam shes/ de dag gi gol sa gcod pa'i yan lag du gzhi shes rnams la sgro 'dogs gcad dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /ci'i phyir nyams len gyi sbyor ba de la bzhir grangs nges zhe na/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i don de rnam par bsdus nas sgom dgos pas rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ de nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i sgo nas dbang thob pa rtse mo'i sbyor ba/ de nyid la blo'i nus pa phul du byung bar bya ba'i phyir go rim du bsgom pa mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ de nyid la brtan pa thob nas cig car du bsgom pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba rnams su grangs nges pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa cung zad phye ste bshad pa la gsum ste/ yul dang /

sbyor ba dang / 'bras bu'o/ /dang po la rnam mkhyen/ lam shes/ gzhi shes gsum las/ dang po rnam mkhyen la gsum ste/ mtshon byed chos kyi grangs nges/ ji ltar mtshon pa'i tshul/ de nyid lus dang sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rnam mkhyen mtshon byed kyi chos de la bcur grangs nges te/ de la bsam pa dang sbyor ba gnyis las/ dang po ni sems bskyed/ gnyis pa la sgrub pa'i rgyu/ 'bras bu sgrub pa/ sgrub pa'i yan lag gi chos dang gsum las/ dang po ni gdams ngag gnyis pa ni nges 'byed yan lag gsum pa la sgrub pa'i rten/ sgrub pa'i dmigs pa/ sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo dang bzhi las/ dang po ni sgrub pa'i rten du gyur pa'i chos dbyings/ gnyis pa ni sgro 'dogs gcad par bya ba'i dmigs pa/ gsum pa ni ched du bya ba chen po gsum/ bzhi pa la 'khor gsum mi dmigs pas go bgos pa dang / go bgos pa ltar theg chen la sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus la zhugs pa dang / zhugs pa'i 'og tu mi mthun phyogs las nges par 'byung ba'i ched du tshogs gnyis gsag pa dang / tshogs kyi dpung sogs pas mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba dang bzhi las/ dang po ni go sgrub/ gnyis pa ni 'jug sgrub/ gsum pa ni tshogs sgrub/ bzhi pa ni nges 'byung sgrub pa yin pa'i phying ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ yul gyis yul can mtshon pa'i tshul gyis mtshon te/ chos bcu po mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa ni rnam mkhyen yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ thub pa'i rnam kun mkhyen pa nyid/ /ces pa ste rnam kun mkhyen nyid ces pa'i rnam mkhyen ngos gzung ba'o/ /lam shes la yang snga ma ltar gsum las/ dang po ni/ lam shes mtshon byed kyi chos de la bcu gcig tu grangs nges te/ de la lam shes bskyed pa'i chos/ rang bzhin/ byed las/ shes bya lam gyi ngo bo dang bzhi las/ dang po gsum po lam shes kyi yan lag ces gcig tu bgrang /

phyi ma la gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa'i lam dang / rang mngon du bya ba'i lam gnyis/ dang po la nyan thos kyi rigs can la bstan par bya ba dang / rang rgyal gyi rigs can la bstan par bya ba gnyis las/ dang po ni shes bya nyan thos kyi lam/ gnyis pa ni shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam/ rang mngon du bya ba'i lam la yang sgrib pa phyogs gcig spang ba'i gnyen po dang / mtha' dag spang ba'i gnyen po gnyis las/ dang po ni mthong ba'i lam/ gnyis pa la sgom lam gyi byed pa dang / byed pa can gyi sgom lam gnyis las/ dang po ni byed pa drug gnyis pa la rjes thob dag pa 'jig rten pa'i rang bzhin dang / mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i rang bzhin gnyis/ dang po la bsod nams ma skyes pa skyed par byed pa dang / skyes pa byang chub kyi rgyur bsgyur bar byed pa dang / bsod nams kyi tshogs yongs su spel bar byed pa dang gsum las/ dang po la mos pa dngos dang / mos pa'i phan yon gnyis/ gnyis pa ni bsngo ba sgom lam/ gsum pa ni rjes su yi rang sgom lam/ mnyam gzhag rnam par mi rtog pa'i rang bzhin la yon tan mngon par sgrub par byed pa dang / mi mthun phyogs dag par byed pa gnyis las/ dang po ni sgrub pa sgom lam/ gnyis pa ni rnam dag sgom lam yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas mtshon te/ phal cher ba'i dbang du byas nas chos bcu gcig po 'di lam shes kyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' mkhas rnams kyi/ /lam shes nyid ni de 'drar bshad/ /ces pa ste lam shes nyid ces pa'i lam shes ngos gzung ba'o/ /gzhi shes la yang sngar ltar gsum las/ gzhi shes mtshon byed kyi chos de la dgur grangs nges te/ de la 'jug yul gzhi shes/ 'jug pa sbyor ba/ zhugs 'bras mthong lam dang gsum/ dang po la gzhi shes kyi ngo bo dang / nye ring gi rgyu mtshan dang mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po'i khyad par dang gsum/

dang po la shes pas srid la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes dang / snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes/ gnyis pa la 'bras yum la ring ba'i gzhi shes dang / 'bras yum la nye ba'i gzhi shes gnyis/ gsum pa la mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang / gnyen po gzhi shes gnyis/ 'jug pa sbyor ba la sbyor ba'i dbye ba dang / de'i mnyam nyid gnyis su nges pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ ngo bo'i sgo nas mtshon te/ phal cher ba'i dbang du byas nas chos dgu po ni gzhi shes kyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ nyan thos la sogs pa'i/ de 'dra kun shes nyid du 'dod/ /ces pa ste/ de nas thams cad shes pa nyid/ /ces pa'i skabs kyi gzhi shes ngos gzung ba'o/ /mkhyen pa gsum lus dang sbyar ba'i skabs su thub pa'i zhes sogs rten gyi gang zag kyang smos pa ni/ mchod brjod kyi mkhyen pa gsum dang sbyar ba'i ched yin no/ /gnyis pa sbyor ba la bzhi las/ dang po rnam rdzogs sbyor ba la gsum ste/ mtshon byed kyi chos kyi grangs nges/ ji ltar mtshon pa'i tshul/ lus dang sbyar ba'o/ /dang po ni/ rnam rdzogs sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos de la bcu gcig tu grangs nges te/ de la sbyor ba sgom pa la 'jug pa'i tshul/ zhugs pa'i rten gyi gang zag bsgom bya sbyor ba'i ngo bo dang gsum/ dang po la bsgom bya dang / sgom pa'i rnal 'byor dang / sngon 'gro'i chos dang / nye rgyu dang bzhi/ dang po ni rnam pa/ gnyis pa ni sbyor ba/ gsum pa la yon tan/ skyon/ mtshan nyid dang gsum/ bzhi pa ni thar pa cha mthun/ zhugs pa'i rten gyi gang zag la sbyor ba skyes pa'i gnas skabs dang / rten gyi gang zag dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni nges 'byed cha mthun/ gnyis pa ni slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs/ bsgom bya sbyor ba'i ngo bo la chos sku'i rgyu dang / gzugs sku'i rgyu dang / phrin las kyi rgyu gsum/ dang po ni srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba/

gnyis pa ni zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba/ gsum pa ni thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ ngo bo'i sgo nas mtshon te/ phal cher ba'i dbang du byas nas chos bcu gcig po 'di rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa ste/ /zhes pa ste/ rnam kun mngon rdzogs rtogs pa dang zhes pa'i rnam rdzogs sbyor ba ngos 'dzin pa'o/ /rtse sbyor la yang sngar ltar gsum las/ dang po ni/ rtse sbyor mtshon byed kyi chos de la yang brgyad du grangs nges te/ de la sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor dang bzhi las/ dang po la rtags dang / rnam 'phel dang / brtan pa dang / sems kun tu gnas pas mtshon pa'i rtse sbyor bzhi/ gnyis pa ni mthong spang bzhi'i gnyen po bar chad med lam/ gsum pa ni sgom spang bzhi'i gnyen po bar chad med lam/ bzhi pa la dngos dang / bsal bya gnyis las/ dang po ni bar chad med pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ gnyis pa ni bsal bya log sgrub yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni ngo bo'i sgo nas mtshon te/ phal cher ba'i dbang du byas nas chos brgyad po 'di rtse sbyor gyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /lam shes sogs la phal cher ba smos pa'i don ni/ lam shes kyi yan lag dang po gsum dang / byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba dang / yon tan dang / skyon dang / slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs dang / bsal bya log sgrub rnams de dang de'i ngo bo yin pa bsal ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ rtse mo'i mngon rtogs zhes pa ste/ rtse sbyor phyin dang zhes pa'i rtse sbyor ngos 'dzin pa'o/ /mthar gyis pa la yang sngar ltar gsum las/ dang po ni/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos de la bcu gsum du grangs nges te/ de la sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa dang / bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa dang /

de gnyis rnam par dag byed kyi chos gsum las/ dang po la pha rol tu phyin pa drug gnyis pa la lam gyi rten dang / de'i gzhi dang / de nyams su len pa'i dpang po rjes su dran pa gsum las/ dang po la dkon mchog gsum rjes su dran pa gsum/ gnyis pa la tshul khrims dang gtong ba rjes su dran pa gnyis/ gsum pa ni lha rjes su dran pa/ de gnyis rnam par dag byed kyi chos ni dngos med ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ ngo bo'i sgo nas mtshon te/ chos bcu gsum po ni mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ mthar gyis pa zhes pa ste/ lus kyi tshig dang khyad par mi snang ngo / /skad cig ma'i sbyor ba la yang sngar ltar gsum las/ dang po ni/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba mtshon byed kyi chos bzhir grangs nges te/ de la rtogs rigs mngon du byed pa'i tshul dang / shes bya rtogs pa'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po la rnam par smin pa ma yin pa'i zag med kyi rtogs rigs mngon du byed pa dang / rnam par smin pa'i zag med kyi rtogs rigs mngon du byed pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rnam par smin pa min pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/ phyi ma ni rnam par smin pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/ gnyis pa la chos thams cad mtshan nyid med par rtogs pa dang / chos thams cad gnyis su med par rtogs pa gnyis las dang po ni mtshan nyid med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba/ phyi ma ni gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba ste rgyun mtha'i ye shes nyid la mtshan nyid don ldog mi 'dra ba bzhir phye ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ ngo bo'i sgo nas mtshon te/ chos bzhi po ni skad cig ma'i sbyor ba'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ skad cig gcig gis mngon rdzogs byang chub/ /ces pa ste/ skad cig gcig gis mngon rdzogs byang chub/

/ces pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba ngos 'dzin pa'o/ /gsum pa 'bras bu chos sku la yang sngar ltar gsum las/ dang po ni/ chos sku mtshon byed kyi chos de la bzhir grangs nges te/ de la chos sku dngos dang / de'i mdzad pa gnyis las/ dang po la ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ sprul pa'i sku dang gsum du nges pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ ngo bo'i sgo nas mtshon te/ sku gsum dang byed pa po la yod pa'i phrin las ni chos sku'i ngo bo yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ chos sku zhes pa ste/ chos kyi sku dang zhes pa'i chos sku dngos ngos 'dzin pa'o/ /gnyis pa tshig don yan lag rgyas par bshad pa la gsum ste/ rgyas pa la dad pa la brgyad du phye/ bar pa la dad pa la drug tu bstan/ bsdus pa la dad pa la gsum du bsdu ba'o/ /dang po la brgyad las/ dang po rnam mkhyen la mtshan nyid ni/ bden pa gnyis rnam pa skye med du mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug go /de la dbye na yul gyi sgo nas dang / bstan tshul gyi sgo nas dang / mtshon byed chos kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang gsum las/ dang po la ji lta ba mkhyen pa'i dang / ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen gnyis/ mtshan nyid rim pa bzhin/ chos dbyings glo bur gyi dri ma mtha' dag dang bral ba mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug dang / chos can ji snyed pa'i dbye ba mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug go /gnyis pa la shes bya ma lus pa mkhyen pa'i rnam mkhyen dang / rgyu 'bras kyi gtso bo mkhyen pa gnyis/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ rnam rtags mtshan mas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug sems bskyed la sogs pa'i chos bcu mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug go /gsum pa la bcu las/ dang po theg chen sems bskyed la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzhan don du rdzogs pa'i byang chub la dmigs pa'i 'dod pa dang /

mtshungs ldan du 'byung ba'i gtso bo rnam rig go /gnyis pa la ngo bo'i sgo nas/ yul gyi sgo nas/ sa mtshams kyi sgo nas/ dpe grogs chos mthun gyi sgo nas dbye ba dang bzhi las/ dang po la theg chen gyi smon pa sems bskyed dang / 'jug pa sems bskyed gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ so so skye bo'i rgyud kyi theg chen sems bskyed gang zhig theg chen gyi bslab pa'i grogs kyis ma zin pa/ sa mtshams theg chen lam du 'jug kha ma'i gnas skabs dang / byang sems kyi bslab pa las nyams pa'i tshe theg chen gyi tshogs lam na yang yod do/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi bslab pa'i grogs kyis zin pa/ deng sang gi lugs dang bstun na theg chen gyi kun rdzob sems bskyed gang zhig ces brjod dgos par mngon no/ /sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam chung ngu nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod do/ /gnyis pa la theg chen gyi kun rdzob sems bskyed dang / theg chen gyi don dam sems bskyed gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen sems bskyed gang zhig rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyis ma bsdus pa/ sa mtshams tshogs sbyor gyi mnyam rjes gnyis ka dang / sa bcu'i rjes thob rnams na yod/ phyi ma'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen sems bskyed gang zhig rnam par mi rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor gyur pa/ sa mtshams sa bcu'i mnyam gzhag dang sangs rgyas kyi sa na yod/ gsum pa la mos pas spyod pa'i sems bskyed/ lhag bsam rnam par dag pa'i sems bskyed/ rnam par smin pa'i sems bskyed/ sgrib pa spangs pa'i sems bskyed dang bzhi las/ dang po ni tshogs sbyor gyi gnas skabs kyi sems bskyed dang / gnyis pa ni ma dag pa sa bdun gyi dang / gsum pa ni dag pa sa gsum gyi sems bskyed dang / bzhi pa ni sangs rgyas kyi sa'i sems bskyed la 'jog go /bzhi pa la dpe'i sgo nas dbye na sa lta bu'i sems bskyed la sogs pa nyer gnyis/

grogs kyi sgo nas dbye na 'dun pa dang ldan pa'i sems bskyed la sogs pa nyer gnyis/ chos mthun gyi sgo nas dbye na chos dkar po thams cad kyi gzhir gyur pa'i sems bskyed la sogs pa nyer gnyis te don gcig go /gnyis pa gdams ngag la/ spyir gdams ngag tsam gyi mtshan nyid/ 'bras bu bde blag tu thob pa'i thabs ston par byed pa'i gdams ngag de la dbye na mngon mtho'i gdams ngag nges legs kyi gdams ngag gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ 'khor ba'i bde 'bras tsam bde blag tu thob pa'i thabs ston par byed pa'i ngag gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ byang chub gsum po gang rung bde blag tu thob pa'i thabs ston par byed pa'i ngag de la dbye na theg dman gyi gdams ngag dang / theg chen gyi gdams ngag gnyis las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gdul bya theg dman gyi rigs can la theg dman gyi byang chub bde blag tu thob pa'i thabs ston par byed pa'i ngag phyi ma'i mtshan nyid/ gdul bya theg chen gyi rigs can la theg chen gyi byang chub bde blag tu thob pa'i thabs ston par byed pa'i ngag skabs 'dir bstan gyi gdams ngag la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba dang / gdams bya yul gyi rnam gzhag dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gdul bya byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa'i gang zag la rnam mkhyen bsgrub pa'i ched du yul bcu po gang rung nyams su len tshul ston par byed pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig gnyis pa la bcu las/ dang po sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo yul bden gnyis las mi 'da' bar yul can thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo nas nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig gnyis pa dmigs yul 'phags pa'i bden pa la 'doms pa la bzhi las/ sdug bsngal bden pa la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ yul bden gnyis las mi 'da' bar yul can thabs shes zung 'jug gi sgo nas sdug bsngal bden pa'i stong nyid dang yul can sher phyin gnyis de bzhin nyid kyi ngo bo rang bzhin gcig pa nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig

sgo nas zhes pa yan chad kun la gsal byed du sbyar la/ kun 'byung bden pa la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ sgo nas kun 'byung bden pa sngar med gsar du kun 'byung ba sogs kyi spros pa dang bral ba nyid du nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig 'gog bden la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ sgo nas glo bur dri bral gyi stong nyid gzugs nas byang chub kyi bar gyi spros pa dang bral ba nyid du nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig lam bden la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ sgo nas don phan tshun bsgom bya sgom byed sogs kyi spros pa dang bral ba nyid du nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig go /gsum pa sgrub pa'i rten la 'doms pa la gsum las/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ sgo nas sangs rgyas dang byang chub dbyings dang ye shes su zhen pa bkag pa sogs kyi sgo nas sangs rgyas dkon mchog nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig chos dkon mchog la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ sgo nas gzhi gnyen rnam gsum gyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams ngo bo nyid med par nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig dge 'dun dkon mchog la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ sgo nas byang sems 'phags pa phyir mi ldog pa rnams skye ba med pa nyid du nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig bzhi pa ma zhen pa'i brtson 'grus la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ sgo nas bya ba zhen don gyi le lo'i gnyen po lus sogs ngo bo nyid med par nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig lnga pa yongs su mi ngal ba'i brtson 'grus la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ sgo nas sgyid lug pa'i le lo'i gnyen por gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar bden par rlom pa med pa nyid du nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig

drug pa lam yongs su 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ sgo nas sems zhum pa'i le lo'i gnyen por chos rnams rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa nyid du nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig bdun pa spyan lnga la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ sgo nas spyan lnga laṃ yul yul can rnams de bzhin nyid du gcig pa nyid du nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig brgyad pa mngon shes drug la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ sgo nas mngon shes drug po gzod ma nas zhi ba nyid du nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig dgu pa mthong lam la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ sgo nas mthong spang gi gnyen po theg chen gyi mthong lam nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig bcu pa sgom lam la 'doms pa'i gdams ngag gi mtshan nyid/ sgo nas sgom spang gi gnyen por theg chen gyi sgom lam nyams su len tshul ston pa'i sher phyin gyi mdo tshig go /gsum pa gdams bya yul gyi rnam gzhag la gnyis te/ yul bcur spyir bstan pa dang / rtogs dka' ba dge 'dun dkon mchog bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bcu las/ sgrub pa rang gi ngo bo'i mtshan nyid/ yul bden gnyis las mi 'da' bar yul can thabs shes zung 'brel gyi sgo nas sems bskyed kyi dbye bas 'phangs pa'i nyamaṃs leṃn sgrub par byed pa'i nyams len gang zhig mi dmigs pa'i sgo nas nyan rang dang thun mong min par gyur pa/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas sa bcu rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ dmigs yul 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi las sdug bsngal bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu las nyon gyi 'bras bur gyur pa'i zag bcas kyi dngos po/ dbye na las nyon gyi bdag po'i 'bras bu nyer len gyi phung po/ rgyu mthun gyi 'bras bu las nyon phyi ma rnams so/

/kun 'byung bden pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang 'bras sdug bsngal bden pa bskyed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i las nyon gang rung gis bsdus pa'i zag bcas/ dbye na zag bcas kyi las dang nyon mongs pa gnyis las/ dang po la dge ba'i las/ mi dge ba'i las/ lung ma bstan gyi las gsum mo/ /yang na phan byed kyi las dang / rdzogs byed kyi las gnyis/ yang na bsod nams kyi las dang / bsod nams ma yin pa'i las/ mi g.yo ba'i las dang gsum/ yang na gcig tu dkar ba'i las/ gcig tu gnag pa'i las/ 'dres ma'i las dang gsum mo/ /gnyis pa nyon mongs pa la dbye na/ rtsa nyon drug dang / nye nyon nyi shu'o/ /'gog bden gyi mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi dri ma las grol ba'i so sor brtags 'gog dbye na theg pa gsum gyi myang 'das/ yang na nyon sgrib spangs pa'i so sor brtags 'gog dang / shes sgrib spangs pa'i sosor brtags 'gog gnyis sam/ yang na mthong spang spangs pa'i so sor brtags 'gog dang / sgom spang spangs pa'i so sor brtags 'gog gnyis so/ /nyi snang las/ myang 'das tsam la dbye na/ dge rtsa chad pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang / ngan 'gro yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang / yan lag yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang / srid pa brgyad pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang / srid pa gnyis pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang / 'dod pa'i khams yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang / phung po lhag ma dang bcas pa dang / lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa dang / dgongs pa can gyi mya ngan las 'das pa dang brgyad yod par gsungs so/ /lam bden gyi mtshan nyid/ bdag med mngon sum rtogs pa'i shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ de la theg pa'i sgo nas dbye na nyan thos rang rgyal theg chen gyi lam bden gsum/ de re re la yang lam gyi sgo nas dbye na mthong lam sgom lam mi slob pa'i lam gsum gsum mo/ /ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na mnyam gzhag dang rjes thob gnyis/

dang po la bar chad med lam dang rnam grol lam gnyis so/ /'khor dang bcas pa'i dbang du byas nas lam lnga yod par kun las btus las gsungs so/ /sgrub pa'i rten la gsum las/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid/ 'dus ma byas pa la sogs pa yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i mthar thug gi skyabs gnas/ yon tan brgyad ni/ 'dus ma byas pa/ lhun gyis grub pa/ gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs pa ma yin pa ste rang don gyi yon tan gsum/ mkhyen pa dang / brtse ba dang / nus pa ste gzhan don gyi yon tan gsum/ dbye gzhi rang don gzhan don gnyis te brgyad do/ /chos dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid/ 'gog lam gyi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi rnam byang gi bden pa/ yon tan brgyad ni/ rtog ge'i blos bsam du med pa/ las nyon gnyis med pa/ rgyu tshul min yid byed kyi rnam rtog med pa ste 'gog bden gyi yon tan gsum/ dag pa/ gsal ba/ gnyen po byed pa ste lam bden gyi yon tan gsum/ dbye gzhi 'gog lam gnyis te brgyad do/ /dge 'dun dkon mchog gi mtshan nyid/ rig grol gyi yon tan brgyad dang ldan pa'i rgyal sras 'phags pa/ yon tan brgyad ni/ ji lta ba rig pa/ ji snyed pa rig pa/ so sor rang gis rig pa ste rig pa'i yon tan gsum/ chags pa'i sgrib pa/ thogs pa'i sgrib pa/ dman pa'i sgrib pa las sgrol ba ste grol ba'i yon tan gsum/ dbye gzhi rig grol gnyis te brgyad do/ /mtshan nyid 'jog pa'i tshe/ skabs 'dir dngos bstan gyi sangs rgyas dkon mchog ces sogs sbyar ro/ /ma zhen pa'i brtson 'grus kyi mtshan nyid/ lus la sogs pa ngo bo nyid med par rtogs pa'i sgo nas bya ba ngan zhen gyi le lo'i gnyen por gyur pa'i sems byung / yongs su mi ngal ba'i brtson 'grus kyi mtshan nyid/ gzugs nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar la bden par rlom pa med pa'i sgo nas sgyid lug pa'i le lo'i gnyen por gyur pa'i sems byung /

lam yongs su 'dzin pa'i brtson 'grus kyi mtshan nyid/ chos rnams rang bzhin gyis ma skyes pa nyid du rtogs pa'i sgo nas sems zhum pa'i le lo'i gnyen por gyur pa'i sems byung / 'dir yang mtshon bya rnams la skabs 'dir dngos bstan zhes sbyar ro/ /spyan lnga las sha'i spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ phar phyin drug gi nyams len la brten nas dpag tshad brgya la sogs pa mngon sum du mthong ba'i yul can/ lha'i spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ phar phyin drug gi nyams len la brten nas dge ba'i las kyi rnam smin las byung ba'i sems can thams cad kyi 'chi 'pho ba dang / skye ba mngon sum du mthong ba'i yul can/ shes rab kyi spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ phar phyin drug gi nyams len la brten nas chos thams cad la bdag gnyis su rnam par mi rtog pa'i yul can dang / chos kyi spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ phar phyin drug gi nyams len la brten nas 'phags pa'i gang zag thams cad kyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du rtogs pa'i yul can/ sangs rgyas kyi spyan gyi mtshan nyid/ phyin drug la brten nas chos thams cad rnam pa thams cad du mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i yul can no/ /sa mtshams la dang po theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas dang / gnyis pa theg chen gyi sbyor lam nas dang / gsum pa theg chen 'phags pa'i mnyam gzhag nas dang / bzhi pa theg chen gyi 'phags pa'i rjes thob nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar na yod/ lnga pa rjes mthun pa sa bdun pa na yod cing / mtshan nyid pa sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nar yod do/ /mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas rang yul la ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du mngon du gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na drug las/ rdzu 'phrul gyi mngon par shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas sa g.yo ba la sogs pa'i rdzu 'phrul du ma yang dag par 'byor ba'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/

lha'i rna ba'i mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid/ thun mong gi bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems dang / thun mong ma yin pa'i bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi sas bsdus kyi dbang po gzugs can pa la brten nas sgra phra rags thos pa yang dag par 'byor pa'i ting nge 'dzin sogs dang / gzhan gyi sems shes pa'i mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas gzhan gyi sems 'dod chags yod med sogs mngon sum du shes pa yang dag par 'byor pa'i ting nge 'dzin sogs dang / sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran pa'i mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas rang gzhan gyi tshe rabs snga ma rjes su dran pa yang dag par 'byor pa'i ting nge 'dzin sogs dang / lha'i mig gi mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid/ thun mong gi bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems dang / thun mong min pa'i bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi sas bsdus kyi dbang po gzugs can pa la brten nas bskal ba dang ma bskal ba'i gzugs phra rags kun mthong ba yang dag par 'byor pa'i ting nge 'dzin sogs dang / zag pa zad pa shes pa'i mngon shes kyi mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen mnyam gzhag gi sems la brten nas zag pa zad pa'i ngo bo'am thabs mngon du shes pa yang dag par 'byor pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /sa mtshams la dang po lnga bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi thob pa'i lam ma zhugs pa dang / nyan thos phyir mi 'ong dang / dgra bcom gnyis dang / rang rgyal dgra bcom pa dang / theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas sangs rgyas sa'i bar du yod/ drug pa la zag pa zad pa'i thabs shes pa ni theg pa gsum char gyi mthong lam nas yod de/ 'dir zag pa zad pa'i thabs ni zag med bar chad med lam la 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /zag zad rang gi ngo bo shes pa ni theg dman gyi mi slob lam dang / theg chen gyi mthong lam nas yod do/

/dgu pa theg chen gyi mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid dang / bcu pa theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid ni 'og tu 'chad do/ /gnyis pa rtogs dka' ba dge 'dun dkon mchog bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis te/ mtshon byed dpe'i dge 'dun dang / mtshon bya don gyi dge 'dun no/ /dang po la gnyis/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang / rang rgyal gyi dge 'dun no/ /dang po la zung bzhi las/ dang po rgyun zhugs kyi skor la/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa dang / 'bras gnas gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ sbyor lam stan gcig pa'i rtogs pa thob la bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa ma thob pa'i nyan thos gang zhig bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa thob pa'i tshe rgyun zhugs su 'gyur ba'o/ /dbye na rgyun zhugs zhugs pa dad pa'i rjes 'brang dang / chos kyi rjes 'brang gnyis/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa gang zhig dad pa lhag pas gzhan gyis bstan pa'i lam gyi rjes su 'brang ste bden pa mngon par rtogs pa la sbyor ba dang / gang zhig shes rab lhag pas rang nyid kyis bden pa'i dbang du byas pa'i chos kyi rjes su 'brang ste bden pa mngon par rtogs pa la sbyor ba'o/ /rim gyis pa dang / cig char ba'i rgyun zhugs zhugs pa la yang mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba rigs bsgres te shes par bya'o/ /rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ mthong spang kun sbyor gsum spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu la gnas pa'i nyan thos/ dbye na cig car ba'i 'bras gnas dang / rim gyis pa'i 'bras gnas gnyis/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas gang zhig khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa rnam pas cig car spong bar 'gyur ba dang / gang zhig 'bras bu phyi ma gsum mngon du byed pa'i rigs can no/ /'di la dbang po'i sgo nas dbye na/ rim gyis pa'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas dad pas mos pa dang / mthong bas thob pa gnyis las/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/

rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas gang zhig dad pa lhag pas bden pa mngon par rtogs par byas pa dang / gang zhig shes rab lhag pas bden pa mngon par rtogs par byas pa'o/ /skye ba len tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na/ rgyun zhugs srid pa lan bdun pa dang / rigs nas rigs skyes gnyis/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ mthong lam thob pa'i lus rten dang bcas pa'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas tsam po gang zhig 'dod par rigs mthun gyi skye srid bdun blangs nas myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i rigs can dang / mthong lam thob pa'i lus rten dang bcas pa'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas khyad par can gang zhig 'dod par rigs mthun gyi skye srid gnyis sam gsum blangs nas myang 'das mngon sum du byed pa'i rigs can no/ /gnyis pa phyir 'ong gi skor la/ zhugs gnas gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ 'bras bu bzhi'i nang nas phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu 'thob par byed pa'i lam gyi sbyor ba rang rgyud la thob cing / phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i rigs can gyi nyan thos/ dbye na chags bral sngon song gi phyir 'ong zhugs pa dang / rim gyis pa'i phyir 'ong zhugs pa gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ sbyor lam stan gcig pa'i rtogs pa thob cing bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa ma thob pa'i nyan thos gang zhig bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa thob ba'i tshe phyir 'ong du 'gyur ba'o/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rim gyis pa'i rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas gang zhig mthong lam thob rjes su 'dod pa'i sgom spang nyon mongs spong ba'i sbyor ba rang rgyud la thob nges pa'o/ /phyir 'ong 'bras gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig 'dod chags dang bral bas rab tu phye ba'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu la gnas pa'i nyan thos/ dbye na chags bral sngon song dang / rim gyis pa'i phyir 'ong 'bras gnas gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ phyir 'ong 'bras gnas gang zhig mthong lam gyi snga rol du 'dod nyon drug pa spangs pa/

gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid gang zhig mthong lam thob rjes su 'dod nyon drug pa spangs pa'o/ /phyir 'ong 'bras gnas tshe gcig bar chad gcig pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod nyon bdun pa spong ba'i gnyen po zag med kyi dbang po dang / brgyad pa spong ba'i gnyen po zag med kyi dbang po gang rung thob cing / mthong lam thob pa'i lus rten dang bcas pa'i phyir 'ong 'bras gnas gang zhig 'dod par rigs mthun gyi skye srid gcig blangs nas myang 'das mngon du byed pa'o/ /gsum pa phyir mi 'ong gi skor la/ zhugs gnas gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ 'bras bu bzhi'i nang nas phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu 'thob par byed pa'i lam gyi sbyor ba rang rgyud la thob cing phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i rigs can gyi nyan thos/ dbye na chags bral sngon song dang / rim gyis pa'i phyir mi 'ong zhugs pa gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ sbyor lam stan gcig pa'i rtogs pa thob cing / bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa ma thob pa'i nyan thos gang zhig bcu drug pa'i rtogs pa thob pa dang dus mnyam du phyir mi 'ong du 'gyur ba'o/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ phyir 'ong 'bras gnas gang zhig phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob rjes su sgom spang nyon mongs spang ba'i sbyor ba rang rgyud la thob pa'o/ /phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ 'dod nyon dgu pa spangs pa'i nyan thos slob pa 'bras gnas/ de la 'bras bu thob tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na chags bral sngon song dang / rim gyis pa'i phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas gnyis las/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ mthong lam gyi snga rol du 'dod nyon dgu pa spangs pa dang / mthong lam thob rjes su 'dod nyon dgu pa spangs pa'i nyan thos slob pa 'bras gnas so/ /rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na lnga/ gzugs su nyer 'gro/ gzugs med nyer 'gro/ mthong chos zhi/ tshe yongs gyur 'phags pa/ lus mngon byed do/ /dang po'i mtshan nyid/

mthong lam thob pa'i lus rten dang bcas pa'i phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can gang zhig gzugs su skye ba blangs nas myang 'das mngon du byed pa'o/ /dbye na bar 'da' ba/ skyes 'da' ba/ gong 'pho dang gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gzugs su nyer 'gro'i phyir mi 'ong gang zhig gzugs kyi bar srid gcig kho nar blangs nas bar srid kyi rten la myang 'das mngon du byed pa/ dbye na myur bar 'da' ba dang / myur bar min par 'da' ba dang / dus ring mo zhig nas 'da' ba dang gsum mo/ /gzugs su nyer 'gro'i skyes 'da' ba'i mtshan nyid/ gzugs su skyes nas myong 'gyur gyi las can gyi gzugs su nyer 'gro'i phyir mi 'ong gang zhig gzugs su skye srid gcig kho nar blangs nas de'i rten la myang 'das mngon du byed pa'o/ /dbye na skyes tsam na 'da' ba dang / mngon par 'du byed med par 'da' ba dang / mngon par 'du byed dang bcas te 'da' ba dang gsum mo/ /gzugs su nyer 'gro'i gong 'pho'i mtshan nyid/ gzugs kyi lan grangs gzhan la myong 'gyur gyi las can gyi gzugs su nyer 'gro'i phyir mi 'ong gang zhig gzugs su skye ba brgyud mar blangs nas khams gong gi rten la myang 'das mngon du byed pa'o/ /dbye na 'og min mthar thug 'gro dang / srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro'i gong 'pho gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gzugs su nyer 'gro'i gong 'pho gang zhig bsam gtan spel sgom las nyams te/ gzugs su skye ba brgyud mar blangs te/ 'og min gyi rten la myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i rigs can/ dbye na 'phar ba dang / phyed du 'phar ba dang / gnas thams cad du 'chi 'pho ba dang gsum/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ 'og min mthar thug 'gro'i gong 'pho gang zhig bsam gtan spel sgom las nyams te/ phyi ma tshangs ris su skyes nas 'phar thebs gcig gis 'og min du myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i rigs can no/ /de gang zhig bsam gtan spel sgom las nyams te/

phyi ma tshangs ris su skyes te/ 'phar thebs gnyis kyis 'og min du myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i rigs can dang / de gang zhig bsam gtan spel sgom las nyams nas gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun du rim gyis skye ba blangs te/ 'og min gyi rten la myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i rigs can no/ /srid rtse'i mthar thug 'gro'i gong 'pho'i mtshan nyid/ rgyu'i dus su bsam gtan spel sgom ma spyad pas tshangs ris nas 'bras bu che ba'i bar du rim gyis skyes te gnas gtsang mar mi 'gro bar gzugs med bzhir skye ba blangs nas srid rtse'i rten la myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i rigs can no/ /gzugs med nyer 'gro'i phyir mi 'ong gi mtshan nyid/ gzugs la 'dod chags dang bral ba'i 'dod pa'i rten can gyi phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can gang zhig gzugs med kho nar skye ba blangs nas gzugs med kyi rten la myang 'das mngon du byed pa/ dbye na gzugs med nyer 'gro'i skyes tsam nas 'da' ba/ 'du byed med par 'da' ba/ de dang bcas te 'da' ba/ gong 'pho dang bzhi'o/ /mthong chos zhi'i mtshan nyid/ mthong lam thob pa'i lus rten dang bcas pa'i phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas khyad par can gang zhig rten de nyid la myang 'das mngon du byed pa'o/ /tshe yongs gyur 'phags pa'i mtshan nyid/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas gang zhig mthong lam thob pa'i lus rten dor ba'o/ /lus mngon byed kyi mtshan nyid/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas gang zhig 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug thob pa'o/ /bzhi pa dgra bcom gyi skor la/ zhugs gnas gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ 'bras bu bzhi'i nang nas dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu 'thob par byed pa'i lam gyi sbyor ba rang rgyud la thob cing / dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu mngon du byed pa'i rigs can gyi nyan thos/ dbye na cig car ba dang / rim gyis pa'i dgra bcom zhugs pa gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas gang zhig

'dod nyon dang po dang srid nyon dang po cig car spangs pa'i sbyor ba rang rgyud la thob pa/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ phyir mi 'ong gi 'bras bu thob rjes su sgom spang nyon mongs spong ba'i sbyor ba rang rgyud la thob pa'o/ /dgra bcom 'bras gnas kyi mtshan nyid/ khams gsum gyi nyon mongs ma lus pa spangs pa'i nyan thos/ dbye na cigacar ba dang rim gyis pa'i dgra bcom 'bras gnas gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ 'dod nyon dgu pa dang srid nyon dgu pa cig car spong ba'i nyan thos/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ khams gsum gyi nyon mongs pa rnams rim gyis spangs pa'i dge sbyong tshul gyi 'bras bu la gnas pa'i nyan thos/ de la dbang po'i sgo nas dbye na/ dus sbyor dang / dus mi sbyor gnyis/ rigs kyi sgo nas dbye na/ yongs su nyams pa'i chos can dang / 'chi bar sems pa'i chos can dang / rjes su bsrung ba'i chos can dang / gnas pa las mi bskyod pa'i chos can dang / rtogs pa'i skal ba can dang / mi g.yo ba'i chos can dang drug go /'dir dgra bcom 'bras gnas mtshon byed dpe'i dge 'dun min yang bshad pa'i skabs bde bas phyogs gcig tu bshad do/ /gnyis pa rang sangs rgyas kyi mtshan nyid/ 'dod pa'i khams su srid pa tha ma pa'i rten la slob dpon gzhan gyi gdams ngag la ma ltos par rang byung gi byang chub mngon du byed pa'i theg dman gyi gang zag go /de la dbye na nyan thos cig car ba'i rtogs pa sngon du song ba'i rang sangs rgyas dang / rang rgyal gyi tshogs sbyor sngon du song ba'i rang sangs rgyas so/ /phyi ma la se ru lta bu dang / tshogs na spyod pa gnyis/ phyi ma la yang skye ba gcig thog gi rten la bzod 'bring man sngon du song ba so skye sngon song dang / 'bras bu dang po gnyis gang rung sngon du song ba nyan thos sngon song gnyis so/ /gnyis pa mtshon bya don gyi dge 'dun ni/ sa dang po nas bcu pa'i bar la gnas pa'i rgyal sras 'phags pa ste/

rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa nges 'byed yan lag la/ mtshan nyid/ ming gi rnam grangs/ dbye ba/ skabs su bab pa bye brag tu bshad pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ theg pa rang lugs kyi tshogs rdzogs rjes su byung zhing theg pa rang lugs kyi mthong lam ma skyes gong gi lam zhugs kyi rtogs pa/ gnyis pa ni/ nges 'byed yan lag nges 'byed cha mthun/ sbyor lam zhes pa rnams mtshan nyid gcig gis mtshon par bya'o/ /deng sang mtshon bya mi 'dra ba tsam la mtshan nyid so sor 'jog dgos par 'dod pa ni gsung rab kyi brda chad ma go ba'o/ /gsum pa la theg pa'i sgo nas dbye na/ nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam gsum/ de re re la yang ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog bzhi bzhi'o/ /mngon rtogs rgyan gyi dgongs pa theg pa gsum char gyi drod sogs re re bzhi po la yang chung ngu 'bring chen po gsum gsum yod par bzhed la/ mngon pa gong 'og las theg pa gsum char gyi drod sogs dang po gsum la chung ngu 'bring chen po gsum gsum yod kyi bzod chen dang chos mchog skad cig ma re re nges par bzhed do/ /'di las gzhan du smra ba ni grub mtha' dang / theg pa'i khyad par ma phyed pa'i cal col du shes par mdzod cig bzhi pa la gnyis te/ khyad gzhi mdor bstan pa dang / khyad chos rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ skabs 'dir dngos bstan gyi sbyor lam gyi mtshan nyid/ dmigs rnam sogs khyad chos lnga'i sgo nas theg dman gyi sbyor lam las khyad par du 'phags pa'i 'jig rten pa'i sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i ye shes so/ /gnyis pa la/ dmigs rnam rgyu gsum rgyas par bshad/ ldan pa rnam rtog rgyas par bshad/ yongs 'dzin dge bshes rgyas par bshad pa dang gsum las/ dang po la dmigs pa'i khyad par ni/ drod chung ngu'i skabs su bden bzhi'i steng gi mi rtag la sogs bcu drug dmigs par byed pa sogs bcu gnyis so/

/rnam pa'i khyad par ni/ drod chung ngu'i skabs su mi rtag la sogs bcu drug la yang mngon zhen bkag pa sogs bcu gnyis so/ /rgyu'i khyad par ni/ bcu gnyis po re re la yang da lta theg pa gsum char gyi rtogs rigs tshang bas theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mthong lam gyi rgyu byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ skabs 'dir dngos bstan gyi rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ byang sems lam gyi spang bya'i gtso bor gyur pa'i shes sgrib gang zhig gzung 'dzin gang rung du mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ dbye na gzung rtog dang / 'dzin rtog gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig 'gre/ rang yul gzung ba la dmigs nas longs spyad byar mngon par zhen pa'i blo dang / dbye na kun nas nyon mongs gzung rtog dang / rnam byang gzung rtog gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang yul dor bya'i chos la dmigs nas dor bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ dbye na ma rig pa'i gzung ba'i rnam rtog de bzhin du gzugs sogs phung po dang / ming gzugs la mngon par zhen pa dang / mtha' gnyis la chags pa dang / kun byang mi shes pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam la mi gnas pa dang / bdag dang / gzhan dang / rnam dag skyed pa'i gzung ba'i rnam rtog dgu/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang yul ma rig pa la dmigs nas dor bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ des gzhan rnams la 'gre'o/ /rnam byang gzung rtog gi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang yul rnam byang gi chos la dmigs nas blang bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ dbye na rnam byang gi phung po gzung ba'i rnam rtog dang / de bzhin du rnam byang gi skye mched dang / rnam byang gi rigs dang / rnam byang gi skye ba dang / stong nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i don dang / mthong ba dang / sgom pa dang / mi slob pa'i lam gyi gzung ba'i rnam rtog dgu las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig

rang yul rnam byang gi phung po la dmigs nas blang bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ des gzhan rnams la 'gre'o/ /'dzin rtog gi mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang yul 'dzin pa la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ dbye na rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang / btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis/ rdzas 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang yul 'dzin pa la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por bden par mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ dbye na gang zag gi dbang du byas pa'i rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang / chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i rdzas 'dzin rtog pa gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang yul gang zag la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por bden par mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ dbye na bdag rang dbang can du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog de bzhin du gcig pu'i bdag dang / rgyu'i bdag dang / lta ba po la sogs pa'i bdag dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rten gyi bdag dang / rnam byang gi rten gyi bdag dang / mthong lam gyi rten gyi bdag dang / sgom lam gyi rten gyi bdag dang / mi slob lam gyi rten gyi bdag 'dzin pa'i rnam par rtog pa dgu las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang yul bdag rang dbang can la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por bden par mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ des gzhan rnams la 'gre'o/ /chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i rdzas 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang yul phung sogs chos tsam la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por bden par mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ dbye ba skabs lnga par 'chad do/ /btags 'dzin rtog pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang yul 'dzin pa la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ dbye na/ gang zag gi dbang du byas pa'i btags 'dzin rtog pa dang / chos kyi dbang du byas pa'i btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang yul gang zag la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa'i blo/

'di la dbye ba mi snang ngo / /gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang yul phung sogs chos tsam la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ dbye na phung po'i rten can gyi btags 'dzin rtog pa/ de bzhin du skye mched dang / khams dang / rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba dang / rnam byang dang / mthong lam dang / sgom lam dang / khyad par gyi lam dang / mi slob pa'i lam gyi rten can gyi btags 'dzin rtog pa dgu las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang yul phung po la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ des gzhan rnams la 'gre'o/ /gsum pa ni 'dir bstan yongs 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ 'phags pa ltar na byang sems sbyor lam pa theg dman du mi ltung bar theg chen du yongs su 'dzin par byed pa'i khyad chos/ dbye na byang sems sbyor lam pa'i nang gi yongs 'dzin thabs la mkhas pa dang / de'i phyi'i yongs 'dzin dge bshes gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ byang sems sbyor lam pa theg dman du mi ltung bar theg chen du yongs su 'dzin par byed pa'i byang sems sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi thabs khyad par can/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ byang sems sbyor lam pa la ngo bo nyid med pa la sogs kyi chos ston pa'i sgo nas theg dman du mi ltung bar theg chen du yongs su 'dzin par byed pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ slob dpon ltar na 'dir bstan yongs 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ byang sems sbyor lam pa la chos ston pa'i sgo nas theg chen du yongs su 'dzin par byed pa'i khyad par gsum ldan gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ khyad par gsum ni shes rab kyi/ chos ston pa'i/ mi mthun phyogs spangs pa'i khyad par ro/ /bzhi pa sgrub pa'i rten rigs la rigs spyi'i rnam gzhag dang / skabs su bab pa bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la sangs rgyas kyi rigs kyi mtshan nyid/ sems can gyis bsdus pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyu gang zhig

dri mas rnam par dag pa na rang don chos sku 'gyur rung / dbye ba la ngo bo'i sgo nas/ theg pa'i sgo nas/ gnas skabs kyi sgo nas dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po la rang bzhin gnas rigs dang / rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi gsal stong gang rung gi cha gang zhig dri mas rnam par dag pa na ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i khyad chos gsum gang rung du 'gyur du rung ba/ dbye na 'dus byas rang bzhin dang 'dus ma byas rang bzhin gnas rigs gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi gsal ba'i cha gang zhig zag med kyi ye shes su 'gyur du rung ba/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi stong pa'i cha gang zhig dag pa gnyis ldan gyi dbyings mthar thug tu 'gyur du rung ba/ 'di bzhin byas na rang bzhin gnas rigs dang ngo bo nyid sku la 'brel pa cung zad gcig grub 'dra lags so/ /rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs kyi mtshan nyid/ rigs sad pa'i stobs kyis byung ba'i 'dus byas kyi dge rtsa gang zhig dri mas rnam par dag pa na ye shes phyi ma gsum gang rung du 'gyur du rung ba'o/ /rgyud blar/ rgyas 'gyur gyi rigs gzugs sku gnyis su 'gyur du rung bar gsungs pa'i don 'di yin no/ /gnyis pa la/ gnas skabs nyan thos kyi/ gnas skabs rang rgyal gyi/ gnas skabs theg chen gyi rigs gsum las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rigs gang zhig gnas skabs nyan thos kyi byang chub 'thob par 'gyur ba des gzhan gnyis la 'gre'o/ /gsum pa la/ nges pa'i rigs dang / ma nges pa'i rigs gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rigs gang zhig gnas skabs theg pa gzhan du bsgyur du mi rung ba/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rigs gang zhig gnas skabs theg pa gzhan du bsgyur du rung ba'o/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ rtsod pa spang ba gsum/ dang po ni/ skabs 'dir dngos bstan gyi sgrub pa'i rten rigs kyi mtshan nyid/

dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi chos dbyings gang zhig rang gi rten chos byang sems kyi drod yan chad kyi sgrub pa'i rten gzhi byed pa/ gnyis pa la/ byang sems kyi drod kyi sgrub pa'i rten rigs/ de bzhin du byang sems kyi rtse mo dang / bzod pa dang / chos mchog dang / mthong lam dang / sa bdun pa man chad kyi sgom lam dang / gnyen po dang / spong ba dang / sa brgyad pa'i rnam grol lam dang / de'i khyad par gyi lam dang / sa dgu pa'i thun mong min pa'i lam dang / sa bcu pa'i gzhan don go rim du byed pa dang / ye shes rtsol ba mi mnga' bar 'jug pa'i sgrub pa'i rten rigs te bcu gsum mo/ /dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang gi rten chos byang sems kyi drod kyi sgrub pa'i rten gzhi byed pa/ des gzhan rnams la 'gre'o/ /gsum pa la rtsod lan gnyis/ dang po ni/ dngos smra ba na re/ chos dbyings sangs rgyas kyi rigs yin na/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi rigs su gnas par thal/ chos dbyings sems can thams cad la spyir gnas pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rigs de la theg pa gsum gyi rigs tha dad pa gsum du dbyer mi rung bar thal lo zhe na/ gnyis pa la rgyu'i sgo nas rigs su 'jog pa dang / dpe'i sgo nas dbye ba 'thad pa'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i sems kyi chos dbyings kho nar rigs su 'thad de/ theg pa gsum gyi sgrub pas bdag med gsum la ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin byang chub gsum po so sor thob pa'i rgyu yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni chos dbyings rang gi ngo bo la dbye ba med kyang theg pa gsum gyi rigs tha dad du dbyer rung ste/ rten chos sgrub pa dang / dpe'i sgo nas rten gzhi rigs de la theg pa gsum gyi rigs gsum du phye ba'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa sgrub pa'i dmigs pa la/ mtshan nyid dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg chen sgrub pa'i dmigs pa'i mtshan nyid/

theg chen sgrub pas sgro 'dogs gcad par bya ba'i gzhi/ gnyis pa la gsum du dang brgyad du dbye ba la gnyis las/ dang po la dge mi dge lung ma bstan pa gsum/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ lung du bstan pa dang ma bstan pa gang zhig 'dod pa dang mi 'dod pa'i 'bras bu 'byin pa dang / rnam smin 'phen mi nus pa'i chos so/ /gnyis pa la lam gyi sgo nas 'jig rten pa'i dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i rtogs pa gnyis/ spang gnyen gyi sgo nas zag bcas zag med gnyis/ bden gnyis kyi sgo nas 'dus byas 'dus ma byas gnyis/ 'bras bu'i sgo nas thun mong ba'i dang thun mong min pa'i yon tan gnyis/ 'jig rten pa'i mtshan nyid/ khams gsum gyi sred pas 'phangs pa'i chos/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i mtshan nyid/ zag med kyi ye shes kyi stobs kyis byung ba'i chos/ zag bcas kyi mtshan nyid/ zag pa'i sgo drug gang rung gis bsdus pa/ zag med kyi mtshan nyid/ zag pa'i sgo drug gang rung gis ma bsdus pa/ 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid/ rang gi rgyu rkyen las skyes pa/ 'dus ma byas kyi mtshan nyid/ rang gi rgyu rkyen las ma skyes pa/ chos thun mong ba'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid/ 'phags pa'i skye bo thams cad kyi rgyud la 'byung ba'i yon tan gyi rigs/ thun mong min pa'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid/ sangs rgyas kho na'i rgyud la 'byung ba'i yon tan gyi rigs so/ /drug pa sgrub pa'i ched du bya ba'i mtshan nyid/ gang gi dbang du byas nas theg chen gyi sgrub pa byed par 'gyur ba'i theg chen sgrub pa'i thob bya mthar thug gang zhig spangs rtogs gang rung gis bsdus pa/ dbye na sems spangs pa rtogs pa chen po gsum/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ rang rgyud ldan gyi gang zag de sems can kun gyi nang nas mchog nyid du byed pa'i sangs rgyas sa'i sems bskyed/ de ltar byed pa'i sangs rgyas sa'i spangs pa dang / de ltar byed pa'i sangs rgyas sa'i rtogs pa'o/

/sgrub pa rang giṃ ngo bo la mtshan nyid dang dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ theg chen sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen sems bskyed la gnas nas rang gzhan gyi don la brtson zhing byang chub chen po sgrub par byed pa'i nyams len no/ /gnyis pa la/ bstaṃn tshuṃl daṃng ngoṃ boṃ'i sgoṃ naṃs dbyeṃ baṃ gnyis/ dang po la/ yul dang yul can gyi sgrub pa gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ mkhyen gsum la thob bya 'thob byed blang dor bya ba'i yan lag tu thos bsam gyis gtan la phab nas/ sgro 'dogs gcod par byed pa'i byang sems tshogs lam pa'i shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam phal pa'i gnas skabs na yod/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ pha rol tu phyin pa re re zhing phar phyin drug ldan du nyams su len pa la mkhas pa'i brtson 'grus mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ sa mtshams thar pa cha mthun khyad par can nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ mi shes pa dag smra ba nyung na mdzes so/ /gnyis pa la/ go sgrub/ 'jug sgrub/ tshogs sgrub/ nges 'byung gi sgrub pa dang bzhi/ mtshon byed kyi chos bdun pa go sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ phar phyin re re zhing phar phyin drug ldan du nyams su len pa la 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i bsam pas go bgos pa'i byang sems kyi bsam pa khyad par can/ dbye na sbyin pa'i go sgrub nas shes rab kyi go sgrub kyi bar drug dang po'i mtshan nyid/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin drug ldan du nyams su len pa la 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa'i bsam pas go bgos pa'i byang sems kyi bsam pa khyad par can/ des gzhan rnams la 'gre/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam chung ngu nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ brgyad pa 'jug sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ rgyu dang 'bras bus bsdus pa'i theg chen la stong nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i brtson 'grus kyis 'dzegs par gyur pa'i byang sems kyi sbyor ba khyad par can/ dbye na bsam gtan gzugs med la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa/

de bzhin du sbyin sogs dang / lam dang / tshad med bzhi dang / mi dmigs pa'i shes rab dang / 'khor gsum dag pa dang / ched du bya ba dang / mngon par shes pa dang / rnam mkhyen la 'jug pa'i sgrub pa ste dgu'o/ /dang po'i mtshan nyid/ 'jug yul bsam gtan gzugs med la stong nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus kyi 'dzegs par byed pa'i byang sems kyi sbyor ba khyad par can/ des gzhan rnams la 'gre/ 'dir 'jug yul bsam gtan gzugs med dang / tshad med bzhi bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ nyer bsdogs dang / dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ snyoms 'jug gi dngos gzhi thob don du dmigs rnam yongs su sbyong bar byed pa'i thabs kyi dge bas bsdus pa/ de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na bsam gtan dang po'i nyer bsdogs nas srid rtse'i nyer bsdogs kyi bar brgyad/ de re re la yang yid byed kyi sgo nas dbye na/ mtshan nyid rab tu rig pa'i/ mos pa'i rab tu dben pa'i/ dga' ba sdud pa'i/ dpyod pa'i/ sbyor mtha'i/ sbyor mtha'i 'bras bu'i yid byed dang bdun bdun las/ dang po drug ni nyer bsdogs yin la/ bdun pa ni de dang de'i dngos gzhir gtogs so/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi dang / gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po la bzhi las/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ gnyen po'i yan lag rtog dpyod gang rung gis/ 'og sa la 'dod chags dang bral bas rab tu phye ba'i dge sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gang zhig dga' bde phan yon gyi yan lag tu ldan pa'o/ /'di la bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi tsam po dang khyad par can gnyis las/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ bsam gtan dang po'i dngos gzhi gang zhig rtog dpyod gnyis ka ldan pa dang / de gang zhig rtog pa la 'dod chags dang bral zhing dpyod pa tsam dang ldan pa'o/ /bsam gtan gnyis pa'i dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/

nang rab tu dwangs pa gnyen po'i yan lag gis dpyod pa la 'dod chags dang bral bas rab tu phye ba'i sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gang zhig ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i dga' bde phan yon gyi yan lag tu ldan pa'o/ /bsam gtan gsum pa'i dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ gnyen po'i yan lag dran shes bzhin btang snyoms gsum gyis dga' ba la 'dod chags dang bral bas rab tu phye ba'i sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gang zhig dga' bas dben pa'i sems bde phan yon gyi yan lag tu ldan pa/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i dngos gzhi'i mtshan nyid/ gnyen po'i yan lag dran pa dang btang snyoms yongs su dag pas bde ba la 'dod chags dang bral bas rab tu phye ba'i sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gang zhig tshor ba btang snyoms phan yon gyi yan lag tu ldan pa'o/ /rtsod ngor ni mtshon bya rnams la so so'i skye bo'i rgyud kyi bsam gtan dang po'i zhes sogs dang / mtshan nyid rnams la so so'i skye bo'i rgyud kyi sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gang zhig ces gzhi la sbyar nas 'jog go /de la bsam gtan dang po'i rtog dpyod gnyis/ gnyis pa'i nang rab tu dwangs pa dang / gsum pa'i dran shes bzhin btang snyoms gsum/ bzhi pa'i dran pa yongs su dag pa dang / btang snyoms yang dag rnams ni gnyen po'i yan lag yin te/ 'og sa la 'dod chags dang bral bar byed pa'i rtogs rigs yin pa'i phyir ro/ /bsam gtan dang po'i dang gnyis pa'i dga' bde gnyis/ gsum pa'i bde ba/ bzhi pa'i tshor ba btang snyoms rnams ni phan yon gyi yan lag yin te/ bsam gtan la gnas pa rnams kyi lus sems la phan 'dogs par byed pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi char gyi sems rtse gcig pa rnams ni gnas kyi yan lag yin te/ yan lag gzhan rnams kyang 'di la brten nas 'jug pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi la bzhi las/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/

sbyor ba'i dus su gzugs dang thogs pa'i 'du shes rnam par bshig nas nam mkha' mtha' yas so snyam du yid la byas pas dngos gzhi'i dus su de nyid mngon du gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin maṃtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ sbyor ba'i dus su yul nam mkha'i 'du shes bsal nas yul can rnam par shes pa de nyid mtha' yas so snyam du yid la byas pas dngos gzhi'i dus su de nyid sogs so/ /ci yang med pa'i skye mched kyi snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ sbyor ba'i dus su gzung bya ci yang med do snyam du yid la byas pas dngos gzhi'i dus su de nyid sogs so/ /'du shes med 'du shes med min skye mched kyi snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ sbyor ba'i dus su 'du shes rags pa ni nad dang / 'bras dang / zug rngu'o/ /'du shes med pa ni kun tu rmongs pa'o/ /'du shes yod min med min ni zhi ba'o snyam du yid la byas pas/ dngos gzhi'i dus su de nyid mngon du gyur pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /'di la yang rtsod ngor mtshan mtshon gnyis ka gzhi sbyar bya'o/ /gnyis pa tshad med bzhi la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams dang gsum las/ dang po la byams pa tshad med kyi mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi la brten te dmigs yul sems can tshad med pa la dmigs nas/ rnam pa bde ba dang 'phrad par 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan no/ /snying rje tshad med kyi mtshan nyid/ dmigs nas zhes pa yan chad 'gre/ rnam pa sdug bsngal dang bral bar 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan no/ /dga' ba tshad med kyi mtshan nyid/ dmigs nas rnam pa bde ba dang mi 'bral bar 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan no/ /btang snyoms tshad med kyi mtshan nyid/ dmigs nas chags sdang gi nyon mongs pa dang bral bar 'dod pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan no/

/gnyis pa ni/ bzhi po re re la yang sems can la dang / chos la dang / dmigs pa med pa la dmigs pa gsum gsum las/ dang po ni sems can sdug bsngal ba la dmigs/ gnyis pa ni sems can skad cig gis g.yo ba la dmigs/ gsum pa ni sems can sgyu ma lta bu la dmigs pa ste/ mtshan mtshon bcu gnyis kyi sbyor tshul shes par bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ sems can la dmigs pa'i tshad med bzhi ni mu stegs byed dang thun mong ba/ chos la dmigs pa bzhi ni nyan rang dang thun mong ba/ dmigs pa med pa la dmigs pa bzhi ni byang sems kyi thun mong min par byang sa las bshad do/ /dgu pa tshogs sgrub la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba spyir bstan pa dang / rtogs dka' ba bye brag tu bshad pa gsum las/ dang po ni/ mthar thug gi byang chen sgrub pa la nus pa mthu can du gyur pa'i byang sems kyi chos mchog skad cig tha ma yan chad kyi nyams len no/ /gnyis pa la/ snying rje chen po'i tshogs sgrub nas/ gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub kyi bar bcu bdun las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ mthar thug gi byang chen 'byin pa la yang nus pa mthu can du gyur pa'i byang sems kyi chos mchog skad cig tha ma yan chad kyi snying rje'o/ /des bar gyi bcu bzhi la 'gre zhing so so'i rkang grangs gzhung las shes/ sa'i tshogs sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ mthar thug gi byang chen 'byin pa la nus pa mthu can du gyur pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i rjes thob kyi mkhyen pa/ gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ mthar thug gi byang chen 'byin pa la mthu can du gyur pa'i byang 'phags kyi rgyud kyi spong ba gnyen po'o/ /sa mtshams la dang po bco lnga byang sems kyi chos mchog skad cig tha ma nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ sa'i tshogs sgrub sa bcu'i rjes thob dang / gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub sa bcu'i mnyam gzhag na yod/ gsum pa la ye shes kyi tshogs bye brag tu bshad pa/ gzungs kyi tshogs dang /

sa'i tshogs dang / gnyen po'i tshogs bye brag tu bshad pa bzhi/ dang po la ye shes kyi tshogs sgrub kyi mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams sngar bshad pa nyid yin la/ ye shes kyi tshogs kyi mtshan nyid/ stong nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i mkhyen pa'o/ /dbye na nyi shu las/ nang stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi mtshan nyid/ nang stong pa nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pas nang stong pa nyid la sgro 'dogs gcod nus kyi mkhyen pa'o/ /des gzhan rnams la 'gre'o/ /sa mtshams la nang dang / phyi dang / gnyis ka dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes bzhi ni mos spyod bzhi na rim pa bzhin yod/ chen po dang / don dam pa dang / 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas dang / mtha' las 'das pa dang / thog mtha' med pa dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes bdun ni/ sa dang po nas bdun pa'i bar la rim pa bzhin yod/ rang bzhin dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes gnyis ni sa brgyad pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid dang mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes gnyis ni sa dgu pa dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid dang / dngos po stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes gnyis ni sa bcu pa dang / dngos po med pa dang / rang gi ngo bo dang / gzhan gyi ngo bo stong pa nyid rtogs pa'i ye shes gsum ni sangs rgyas kyi sar yod do/ /gnyis pa la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba/ sa mtshams gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzungs kyi mtshan nyid/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas dam pa'i chos 'dzin nus pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan no/ /gnyis pa la/ tshig gi don gyi/ bzod pa'i/ gsang sngags kyi gzungs dang bzhi las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa'i chos rgya chen po mi brjed par 'dzin nus pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan no/

/gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ brten nas sangs rgyas rnams kyis gsungs pa'i don rgya chen po mi brjed par 'dzin nus pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan no/ /gsum pa la/ bzod pa'i rgyur gyur gyi gzungs dang / bzod pa dngos kyi gzungs gnyis las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ brten nas rang bzhin skye med kyi don la 'jig rten pa'i sgom byung gi gsal snang thob pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan no/ /phyi ma'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan no/ /bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ brten nas gzhan la phan pa'i don du sngags rnams kyis rang gi 'bras bu 'grub par byin gyis rlob nus pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan no/ /gsum pa la smon lam dang bsam gtan gyi dbang gis thob pa'i gzungs bzhi char yang theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas yod/ brtan pa dang / rgya che ba'i gzungs bzhi char sa dang po nas yoṃd par gsal lo/ /gzhan dag theg pa gsum gyi tshogs lam chen po nas chos rgyun gyi ting nge 'dzin thob pas khyab par smra zhing / gsung rab mtha' dag gi dgongs 'grel rtsom pa ni/ rgyun zhugs dang / phyir 'ong gnyis 'dod pa la 'dod chags dang ma bral ba'i rnam gzhag tsam yang blo la ma shar bzhin du gdul bya bslu bar byed par snang bas bag yod par gyis shig gsum pa la/ rgyu'i sa'i yongs sbyong dang / 'bras bu'i sa'i ngo bo gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ mnyam gzhag tu thob pa'i sa'i skyon zad cing yon tan sbyong ba'i ched du mnyam gzhag gi rtogs pa dang mthun pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don sgrub par byed pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i rjes thob kyi mkhyen pa'o/ /dbye na sa dang po'i yongs sbyong nas dgu pa'i yongs sbyong gi bar dgu/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ sa dang po'i mnyam gzhag tu thob pa'i skyon zad cing yon tan yongs su sbyong ba'i ched du sa dang po'i rtogs pa dang mthun pa'i sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don sgrub par byed pa'i sa dang po'i rjes thob kyi mkhyen pa'o/

/dbye na rang don yid byed kyis dben pa'i bsam pa la sogs pa bcu'o/ /sa gnyis pa'i yongs sbyong la mtshan nyid 'gre/ dbye na dge ba chos sdud kyi tshul khrims sogs brgyad do/ /sa gsum pa'i yongs sbyong la mtshan nyid 'gre/ dbye na thos pas mi ngoms pa la sogs pa lnga'o/ /sa bzhi pa'i yongs sbyong la mtshan nyid 'gre/ dbye na dgon par gnas pa la sogs pa bcu'o/ /sa lnga pa'i yongs sbyong la mtshan nyid 'gre/ dbye na rnyed bkur gyi don du rabaṃ byuṃng dang 'grogs pa la sogs spong ba bcu'o/ /sa drug pa'i yongs sbyong la mtshan nyid 'gre/ dbye na sbyin pa'i phar phyin sogs bcu gnyis so/ /sa bdun pa'i yongs sbyong la mtshan nyid 'gre/ dbye na spang bya bdag tu lta ba sogs nyi shu spong bar byed pa'i gnyen po rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid yang dag par shes pa sogs nyi shu'o/ /sa brgyad pa'i yongs sbyong la mtshan nyid 'gre/ dbye na sems can kun yid shes nas la sogs pa brgyad do/ /sa dgu pa'i yongs sbyong la mtshan nyid 'gre/ dbye na smon lam mtha' yas pa bcu gnyis so/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu'i sa'i ngo bo la/ mtshan nyid dang / 'da' sa sa dgu ngos gzung ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'da' sa sa dgu las 'das nas de pa'i ming gis gdags su rung ba'i byang sems kyi sa bcu pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ rigs kyi sa dang / brgyad pa'i sa dang / mthong ba'i sa dang / srab pa'i sa dang / 'dod chags dang bral ba'i sa dang / byas pa rtogs pa'i sa dang / nyan thos kyi sa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa dang / byang chub sems dpa'i sa dang dgu'o/ /dang po ni/ nges pa'i nyan rang gi sbyor lam bzhi/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyun zhugs zhugs pa'i mngon rtogs/ gsum pa ni/ rgyun zhugs 'bras gnas tsam po'i mngon rtogs/ bzhi pa ni/ phyir 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po'i mngon rtogs/ lnga pa ni/ phyir mi 'ong 'bras gnas tsam po'i/ drug pa ni/ dgra bcom 'bras gnas kyi/

bdun pa ni/ zhugs pa phyi ma gsum gyi/ brgyad pa ni/ rang rgyal dgra bcom pa'i mngon rtogs/ dgu pa ni/ ji skad bshad pa'i byang sems kyi sa dgu'o/ /bzhi pa la gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub kyi mtshan nyid bshad zin/ dbye na mthong spang gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub dang / sgom spang gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ mthar thug gi byang chen sgrub pa la nus pa mthu can du gyur pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mthong spang gi spong ba gnyen po'o/ /dbye na spang bya gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog bzhi yod pa las/ gnyen po yang de ltar ro/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ mthar thug gi byang chen sgrub pa la nus pa mthu can du gyur pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi sgom spang gi spong ba gnyen po/ dbye na sa gnyis pa nas bcu pa'i spong ba gnyen po'i bar dgu yod cing / de re re la yang spang bya gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog bzhi bzhi yod pas gnyen po'i tshogs sgrub kyang rnam pa bzhi bzhi'o/ /bcu pa nges 'byung sgrub pa'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi nges par 'byung sa brgyad po gang rung du mtshan 'dzin gyi bar chad med par nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i dag sa'i ye shes/ dbye na ched du bya ba'i nges 'byung sgrub pa nas lam gyi yul can gyi nges 'byung sgrub pa'i bar brgyad/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang gi nges par 'byung sa chen po gsum du mtshan 'dzin gyi bar chad med par nges par 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i dag sa'i ye shes/ des gzhan rnams la yang 'gre zhing / sa mtshams yang de nyid kyis rtogs par 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi mtshon byed kyi chos rnams kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa sbas don rab gsal zhes bya ba las skabs dang po'o// //gnyis pa lam shes la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ lam gsum rang bzhin med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i theg chen 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa'o/

/gnyis pa la yul gyi sgo nas dbye ba/ rgyu 'bras kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ mnyam rjes kyi sgo nas dbye ba/ ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba dang bzhi las/ dang po la nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes/ rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes/ byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes dang gsum/ mtshan nyid 'og tu 'byung ngo / /gnyis pa la rgyu'i dang / 'bras bu'i lam shes gnyis/ mtshan nyid gzhan sngar dang 'dra ba las/ byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa zhes dang / sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa zhes sogs sbyar ro/ /gsum pa la theg chen 'phags pa'i mnyam rjes gnyis so/ /bzhi pa la bcu gcig las/ dang po lam shes kyi yan lag la mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ 'phros pa'i don dang gsum/ dang po ni chos lnga gang rung gis bsdus pa'i lam shes kyi khyad chos so/ /gnyis pa la rten gyi yan lag rang bzhin gyi yan lag byed las kyi yan lag dang gsum/ dang po la dngos su dang / brgyud nas skye ba'i rten gnyis/ dang po la lam shes dngos su skye bar rung ba dang / lam shes dngos su skye ba'i yul nges pa gnyis/ dang po ni nga rgyal gyis mtshon pa'i nyon mongs pa mngon gyur ba dang bral ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'o/ /brgyud nas skye ba'i rten ni lam shes dngos su mi skye ba'i sems can thams cad la yang lam shes brgyud nas skye bas khyab pa'o/ /gnyis pa rang bzhin gyi yan lag ni/ gzhan don du 'khor bar skye ba len pa'i rgyur gyur pa'i nyon mongs kyi ming can ched du gnyer nas mi spong ba'o/ /gsum pa byed las kyi yan lag ni sems can 'khor du ma 'dus pa bsdud pa dang / bsdus pa smin pa la sogs pa'o/ /gsum pa la khyab pa las 'phros pa dang / rang bzhin las 'phros pa gnyis/ dang po la/ mthar thug theg pa gcig tu nges pa yin te/ nyan rang dgra bcom lhag med du mya ngan las 'das pa rnams kyang mthar theg chen gyi lam du zhugs nas sangs rgya ba yin pa'i phyir ro/

/'o na de dag dang por theg chen gyi lam gyi sa mtshams gang nas zhugs zhe na/ theg chen gyi tshogs lam chung ngu nas 'jug ste/ theg chen gyi lam du thog mar 'jug pa'i sgo ni 'dun ldan sems bskyed yin pa'i phyir dang / chos kyi bdag med thos bsam gyis gtan la dbab dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na nyan rang theg chen gyi lam du zhugs nas/ theg chen gyi tshogs sbyor gyi gnas skabs su sngar gyi gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor mngon sum de ji ltar ldan zhe na/ dgra bcom gyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba la ni phal cher dbang ldan gyi tshul du ldan cing res 'ga' mngon du gyur pa srid de/ nyon sgrib spangs zin pas dgos pa med pa'i phyir dang / sems can gyi log sgrub kyis yid skyo ba'i tshe na sngar gyi rtogs pa la gnas srid pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyun zhugs sogs kyi rtogs pa sngon du song ba la ni nyon mongs kyi lhag ma spang dgos pas de'i gnyen po gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs sgom pa'i tshe mngon du 'gyur te/ sngar gang zag gi bdag med mngon sum rtogs pa'i mthong lam sngon du song bas de nam zhig sgom pa'i tshe mngon sum du rtogs pa kho na yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de'i tshe chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i tshogs sbyor ni mngon du mi 'gyur te/ de ni chos kyi bdag med don spyi'i tshul gyis rtogs pa'i blo yin la/ cig shos ni rnal 'byor mngon sum yin pa'i phyir ro/ /sems can thams cad sangs rgya ba yin te/ sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la rgyu rigs yod/ 'gal rkyen sgrib pa spong du rung / mthun rkyen sangs rgyas kyi phrin las 'jug tu rung / nyer len gyi rgyu rgyun chad pa mi srid pa'i phyir ro/ /'o na 'khor ba la mtha' yod par 'gyur ro zhe na/ 'khor ba la mtha' med de/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas zin pa'i dus mi srid pa'i phyir te/

sangs rgyas re res sems can dpag tu med pa mya ngan las bzla yang sems can gyi grangs nyung ba mi srid pa'i phyir dang / sems can la grangs med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ byang sems 'phags pas ched du gnyer nas mi spong rgyu'i nyon mongs de dag gang yin zhe na/ 'di la nyon mongs mtshan nyid pa la 'dod pa dang / nyon mongs btags pa ba la 'dod pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i bag chags la 'dod pa dang gsum las/ phyi ma de nyid 'thad de/ rgyud bla'i 'grel par nyan rang dgra bcom pa dang byang sems 'phags pa rnams ma rig bag chags kyi sa dang / zag med kyi las la brten nas yid kyi rang bzhin gyi lus len par gsungs pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes la shes bya nyan thos kyi lam/ yul can de shes pa'i lam shes/ rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun dang gsum las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rtogs rigs gsum gyi nang nas gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa'i sgo nas nyon sgrib kyi gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa/ dbye na gang zag gi sgo nas dang / rnam pa'i sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la nyan thos kyi rgyud kyi shes bya nyan thos kyi lam/ rang rgyal gyi rgyud kyi shes bya nyan thos kyi lam/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi shes bya nyan thos kyi lam dang gsum/ gnyis pa la/ sher phyin gyi mdo las bden pa bzhi'i steng gi mi rtag la sogs pa'i rnam pa nyer drug gsungs te/ sdug bden gyi mi rtag sdug bsngal/ stong pa/ bdag med pa'i rnam pa ste bzhi/ kun bden pa'i nad dang / 'bras dang / zug rngu dang / sdig pa'i rnam pa ste bzhi/ sdug kun thun mong ba'i pha rol dang / 'jig pa'i chos can dang / g.yo ba dang / rab tu 'jig pa dang / 'jigs pa dang nad 'go ba dang / 'tshe ba'i rnam pa ste bdun/ 'gog bden gyi bdaṃg med pa dang / zhi ba dang / dben pa dang / stong pa dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa dang /
