mngon par 'du byed pa med pa'i rnam pa ste bdun/ lam bden gyi lam dang / rigs pa dang / sgrub pa dang / nges par 'byin pa'i rnam pa ste bzhi rnams so/ /'di dag 'phags seng gnyis kas mngon pa nas gsungs pa'i mi rtag sogs bcu drug dang sbyor bar yang mdzad do/ /gnyis pa yul can nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gdul bya nyan thos kyi rigs can rjes su gzung ba'i ched du nyan thos kyi lam gyi dmigs rnam mi dmigs par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa'o/ /gsum pa nyan thos kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ nyan thos kyi lam mngon sum shes pa'i ched du gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs/ 'jig rten pa'i sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i byang sems so skye'i mkhyen pa/ dbye na byang sems kyi drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog bzhi'o/ /gsum pa rang rgyal gyi lam shes pa'i lam shes la/ lam gyi khyad par byed chos/ khyad gzhi lam gyi ngo bo/ rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun dang gsum las/ 'dir bstan lam gyi khyad par byed chos kyi mtshan nyid/ khyad chos gang gis nyan thos dgra bcom las khyad par du byed pa'i theg pa 'bring gi dgra bcom pa'i rgyud kyi ye shes/ dbye na 'dir bstan lam bgrod tshul gyi khyad par dang / chos ston tshul gyi khyad par gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ sangs rgyas dang nyan thos med pa'i 'dod khams su rang byung gi byang chub mngon du byed pa'i theg 'bring skyes bu'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ sangs rgyas dang nyan thos med pa'i zhing khams su sgra med lus kyi rnam 'gyur gyi sgo nas chos ston pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i theg 'bring skyes bu'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa'o/ /gnyis pa la shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam dang / yul can de shes pa'i lam shes gnyis las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/

rtogs rigs gsum gyi nang nas gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rigs su gyur pa'i sgo nas shes sgrib gzung rtog gi gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa'am/ yang na rtogs rigs rang ngos nas gzung rtog spong ba dang / 'dzin rtogs mi spong ba dang / rten gyi khyad par gsum dang ldan pa'i rtogs rigs so/ /dbye na gang zag gi sgo nas dang / rnam pa'i sgo nas dbye ba gnyis/ dang po la rang rgyal gyi rigs can gyi rgyud kyi shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam/ byang sems kyi rgyud kyi shes bya rang rgyal gyi lam gnyis so/ /gnyis pa la rjes thob kyi rnam pa lnga/ mnyam gzhag gi rnam pa drug ste skabs bzhi par 'chad do/ /gnyis pa yul can rang rgyal gyi lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gdul bya rang rgyal gyi rigs can rjes su gzung ba'i ched du rang rgyal lam gyi dmigs rnam mi dmigs par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa'o/ /gsum pa rang rgyal gyi lam shes kyi rgyu nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ rang rgyal gyi lam mngon sum du shes pa'i ched du gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs la 'jig rten pa'i sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i byang sems so skye'i mkhyen pa'o/ /dbye na byang sems kyi sbyor lam drod rtse mo bzod pa chos mchog bzhi'o/ /bzhi pa byang sems kyi lam shes pa'i lam shes kyi mtshan nyid ni/ gdul bya byang sems kyi rigs can rjes su gzung ba dang / rang nyid rnam mkhyen thob pa'i ched du byang sems kyi lam gyi dmigs rnam mi dmigs par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i mkhyen pa/ dbye na theg chen gyi mthong lam dang / sgom lam gnyis las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang bzhin rnam dag gi chos dbyings dang por mngon sum du mthong ba'i mnyam gzhag gi rgyun gyi khongs su gtogs pa'i mkhyen pa gang zhig 'di phyi'i phan yon gnyis dang ldan pa/ dbye na byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod nas lam la rjes shes kyi bar bcu drug

'dir bstan byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal la chos bzod kyi mtshan nyid/ byang sems kyi mthong lam gang zhig de bzhin nyid dang sangs rgyas phan tshun rnam grangs kyis gnas par khas mi len pa la nges shes gtso bor 'dren nus/ des gzhan rnams la yang 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa sgom lam la/ sgom lam gyi byed pa dang / byed pa can gyi sgom lam gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen sgom lam gyi stobs kyis thob pa'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan/ dbye na skye bus byed pa'i 'bras bu dang / rnam smin gyi dang / bdag po'i gsum/ dang po la nang gi nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang phyi'i nyer 'tshe zhi ba gnyis/ dang po la gnas skabs kyi dang mthar thug gi 'bras bu gnyis/ dang po la sems la rang dbang nyid du byed pa dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen sogs la 'dud pa gnyis/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu ni sgom spang nyon mongs spangs pa'o/ /phyi'i nyer 'tshe zhi ba ni gzhan gyi gnod pas mi brdzi ba'o/ /rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ni rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa'o/ /bdag po'i 'bras bu ni rten gyi byang sems bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs kyang mchod par bya ba nyid du byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa theg chen gyi sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi mthong lam mnyam gzhag rdzogs rjes su byung zhing theg chen gyi mi slob lam ma skyes gong gi theg chen skyes bu'i rgyud kyi mngon par rtogs pa/ de la sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye na sa dang pos bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam dang / sa dgus bsdus pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam gnyis/ dang po la mthong lam khyad par lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i seng ge rnam bsgyings dang / rjes thob rten 'brel la rtog pa'i gnas skabs kyi mkhyen pa dang / mthong lam mnyam gzhag gis drangs pa'i nges shes dang / sangs rgyas brgya las chos mnyan pa'i gnas skabs kyi thos bsam gyis bsdus pa'i mkhyen pa dang / gdul bya brgya la chos 'chad pa'i gnas skabs kyi lhag bsam gyi mkhyen pa dang /

ting nge 'dzin brgya la snyoms par 'jug pa'i gnas skabs kyi snyoms 'jug la sogs dpag tu med pa yod pas thugs rtsol che bar mdzod cig gnyis pa ni gzhung nas bshad pa'i sgom lam rnams yin la/ de nyid ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na rjes thob dang mnyam gzhag gnyis/ 'di la 'phags seng gnyis kyis zag bcas sgom lam dang / zag med sgom lam gyi tha snyad mdzad pa ltar na/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi sgom lam gang zhig gzung 'dzin tha dad du snang ba'i yang dag pa ma yin pa'i kun rtog dang bcas pa/ dbye na mos pa bsngo ba rjes su yi rang sgom lam gsum/ dang po la dngos dang / mos pa'i phan yon gnyis las/ mos pa sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ lung rigs kyi rgyu las sher phyin don gsum gyi 'byung gnas su mtha' gcig tu nges par 'dzin pa'i dad pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na rang don/ gnyis don/ gzhan don mos pa sgom lam gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ mos pa sgom lam gang zhig bsam pas gzhan don sgrub cing sbyor bas rang don gtso bor sgrub pa/ dbye na rang don mos pa chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa dgu/ sa mtshams ma dag sa bdun na yod/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig bsam pas gzhan don sgrub cing sbyor bas rang gzhan gyi don cha mnyam du sgrub pa/ dbye na gnyis don mos pa chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs pa dgu/ sa mtshams sa brgyad pa dang dgu pa na yod/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig bsam sbyor gnyis kas gzhan don gtso bor sgrub pa/ dbye na gzhan don mos pa chung ngu'i chung ngu sogs dgu/ sa mtshams sa bcu pa na yod/ mos pa'i phan yon gyi mtshan nyid/ mos pa sgom pa'i byang sems spro ba bskyed pa'i ched du mos pa'i gnas skabs gsum gyi rim pa dang mthun par yon tan brjod pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung / dbye na rang don mos pa'i gnas skabs dgu la bstod pa rnam pa dgu/ gnyis don mos pa'i gnas skabs dgu la bkur ba rnam pa dgu/

gzhan don mos pa'i gnas skabs dgu la bsngags pa rnam pa dgu ste nyi shu rtsa bdun no/ /bsngo ba sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ zag bcas sgom lam gang zhig dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi rgyur yongs su sgyur bar byed pa'i 'dun pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ spyir bsngo ba tsam la dbye na/ mngon mtho'i bsngo ba dang / nges legs kyi bsngo ba gnyis/ phyi ma la byang chub gsum yod kyang 'dir ni tha ma kho na'o/ /sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye na sa dang pos bsdus pa'i bsngo ba sgom lam dang / sa dgu pos bsdus pa'i bsngo ba sgom lam gnyis/ dang po ni sa dang po'i rjes thob na yod/ phyi ma ni sa gnyis pa'i rjes thob nas bcu pa'i rjes thob kyi bar na yod/ khyad chos kyi sgo nas dbye na bcu gnyis yod pa lngar 'dus te/ spyi'i rang bzhin dang / mngon zhen 'gog pa dang / zung 'jug gi rnam pa dang / mi mthun phyogs dang bral ba dang / rnam pa'i rab tu dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ nyan rang las khyad par can gyi bsngo ba'o/ /gnyis pa la dngos por mngon zhen 'gog pa dang / dngos med du mngon zhen 'gog pa gnyis las/ dang po la bsngo bya'i rdzas dang / bsngo byed kyi sems dang / bsngo bar byed pa po dang / bdag dang sangs rgyas kyi dge rtsa thams cad dang / phyin drug la bzang ngan du zhen pa 'gog pa lnga ni/ rim pa ltar/ mi dmigs pa'i ming can dang / phyin ci ma log pa'i ming can dang / dben pa'i ming can dang / sangs rgyas kyi bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi rang bzhin dran pa'i ming can dang / thabs la mkhas pa dang bcas pa'i ming can gyi bsngo ba rnams so/ /dngos med du zhen pa 'gog pa gcig ni mtshan ma med pa'i ming can gyi bsngo ba'o/ /zung 'jug gi rnam pa ni sangs rgyas kyis gnang ba'i ming can gyi bsngo ba'o/ /mi mthun phyogs dang bral ba ni khams gsum par ma gtogs pa'i ming can gyi bsngo ba'o/ /rnam pa'i rab dbye la bsod nams chen po 'byung ba'i bsngo ba chung ngu dang /

'bring dang / chen po'i ming can gyi bsngo ba gsum mo/ /rjes su yi rang sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ zag bcas sgom lam gang zhig thabs shes zung 'jug gi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi dge ba la dga' ba sgom par byed pa'i dad pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye na sngar bzhin no/ /theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi sgom lam gang zhig gzung 'dzin tha dad du snang ba'i yang dag pa min pa'i kun rtog dang bral ba'i sgo nas chos nyid mthong zin rgyun ldan du goms par byed pa'i mkhyen pa/ dbye na sgrub pa sgom lam dang / rnam dag sgom lam gnyis/ dang po'i ngo bo/ khyad par/ rnam pa/ byed pa dang bzhi las/ ngo bo ni gzugs sogs kyi gnas tshul mthong zin sgom par byed pa'o/ /khyad par ni sbyin sogs gzhan las mchog tu gyur pa'o/ /rnam pa ni yul kun la mngon zhen med pa'o/ /mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam gang zhig rang gi ngos skal gyi shes sgrib kyi spong ba gnyen por gyur pa/ sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye na/ sa gnyis pa'i zag med sgom lam nas sa bcu pa'i zag med sgom lam gyi bar dgu/ de re re la'ang sbyor ba'i lam dang / bar chad med pa'i lam gnyis gnyis su 'byed dgos so/ /khyad chos kyi sgo nas byed pa la gnyis las/ gnas skabs kyi byed pa ni rnal 'byor pa'i rgyud la chos rnams mi dmigs pa nyid du rtogs pa bskyed pa'o/ /mthar thug gi byed pa ni don chen po sangs rgyas nyid du byed pa'o/ /gnyis pa rnam dag sgom lam la rgyu dang rgyu ma yin pa'i rab dbye dang / 'bras bu rnam dag sgom lam dngos gnyis las/ dang po rnam dag sgom lam gyi rgyu'i mtshan nyid/ rnam dag sgom lam skyed par byed pa'i mthun rkyen/ dbye na mnyes par byed pa dang / sbyin sogs rdzogs par byed pa dang / zhi gnas kyi thabs la mkhas pa gsum mo/ /gnyis pa rnam dag sgom lam gyis 'phangs pa'i rgyu ma yin pa'i mtshan nyid/

rnam dag sgom lam skye ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'gal rkyen/ dbye na bdud kyis gnod pa byas pa dang / mi dge ba'i grogs po dang 'grogs pa dang / chos zab mo la ma mos pa dang / dngos por mngon par zhen pa dang bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa 'bras bu rnam dag dngos la/ rnam dag sgom lam gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi zag med sgom lam gang zhig rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngo skal gyi shes sgrib las grol ba'i rnam dag de la sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye na sa gnyis pa'i rnam grol lam nas/ sa bcu pa'i rnam grol lam gyi bar du dgu yod do/ /'di nyid nges par bya ba 'phags bzhi'i rnam dag spyir bstan pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag shin tu bar sgrub pa/ sgrub byed la klan ka spang ba dang gsum las/ dang po la nyan thos kyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi nyon sgrib las grol ba'i nyan thos kyi rgyud kyi zag med kyi rnam grol lam/ de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na 'dus byas rnam grol lam dang / 'dus ma byas so sor btags 'gog gnyis/ sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye na rgyun zhugs/ phyir 'ong gi phyir mi 'ong gi dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu dang bzhi/ spang bya'i sgo nas dbye na mthong spang nyon mongs spangs pa'i rnam dag dang / sgom spang nyon mongs spangs pa'i rnam dag gnyis/ phyi ma la dbye na gya gcig go /rang rgyal gyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyi nyon sgrib dang shes sgrib gzung rtog las grol ba'i theg 'bring gi rgyud kyi zag med kyi rnam grol lam/ dbye ba rnams ni snga ma ji lta ba bzhin du 'byung ste/ ṭī ka las/ mdo las kyang rgyun zhugs kyi 'gres nyan thos kho na la sbyar gyi/ rang rgyal la rgyun zhugs sogs ma gsungs pas mi gzung ngo / /zhes gsungs pa ni/ rang rgyal yin par gyur pa'i rgyun zhugs dang / phyir 'ong dang /

phyir mi 'ong med ces pa'i don yin te/ rang rgyal gyi lam la gnas pa'i rgyun zhugs dang / phyir 'ong dang / phyir mi 'ong gsum po nyan thos yin pa'i phyir dang / rang sa las rang sangs rgyas kyi lam bsgrod tshul gsum pa'i skabs su 'di na la la bskal pa brgyar sangs rgyas 'byung ba mnyes par byas nas tshe 'dir rgyun zhugs sam/ phyir 'ong gi 'bras bu thob nas tshe 'di nyid la dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu thob par ma nus pas phyi ma la phyir mi 'ong dang / dgra bcom gyi 'bras bu thob pa'i phyir du phung po sogs drug la mkhas par byed par gsungs shing / de nyid ṭī ka las ji lta ba bzhin du rnam gzhag mdzad pa'i phyir ro/ /des na rgyun zhugs yin na nyan thos yin dgos kyang / rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu yin na nyan thos kyi rnam dag yin pas ma khyab par rang rgyal gyi rigs can gyi slob pa thams cad nyan thos su khas len byas pa'i lugs 'di la 'thad pa yin no/ /byang sems kyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ rang rgyu bar chad med lam gyi ngos skal gyis theg pa gsum gyi spang bya'i rigs las grol bas byang sems kyi rgyud kyi rnam grol lam/ 'di la yang ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na ni sngar bzhin yin la/ spang bya'i sgo nas dbye na mthong spang spangs pa'i dang / sgom spang gi cha shas spangs pa'i rnam dag gnyis/ phyi ma la sa gnyis pa'i dri ma spangs pa'i na sa dgu pa'i dri ma spangs pa'i rnam dag gi bar te brgyad yod cing / sa bcu pa la rnam grol lam yod pa ltar na dgu yod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi rnam dag gi mtshan nyid/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa spangs pas rab tu phye ba'i zag med rnam byang gi bden pa/ de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na 'dus byas rnam grol lam dang 'dus ma byas so sor btags 'gog go /dang po la zag med kyi ye shes sde tshan nyer gcig tu dbyer rung ngo / /gnyis pa shin tu bar sgrub pa ni/

de'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ theg chen gyi sgom lam bar chad med lam dgu po de khams gsum sa dgu'i sgom spang shes sgrib mtha' dag gi gnyen po yin pa'i phyir te/ 'dod pa'i sas bsdus kyi sgom spang shes sgrib rnams che 'bring chung gsum du bsdus nas sa gnyis pa gsum pa bzhi pa gsum gyis rim bzhin du spang ngo / /gzugs kyi de rnams der bsdus nas sa lnga pa drug pa bdun pa gsum gyis rim bzhin du spong / gzugs med kyi de rnams der bsdus nas sa brgyad pa dgu pa bcu pa gsum gyis rim pa bzhin du spong ba'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa klan ka spang ba ni gnyen po chung rim nas skye zhing spang bya che rim nas 'gag pa mi 'thad do zhe na/ skyon med de/ gos la chags pa'i dri ma rags pa 'bad pa chung ngus ni sel zhing phra mo sel ba la 'bad pa chen po dgos pa'i dpes 'thad pa grub pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi mtshon byed kyi chos rnams kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa sbas don rab gsal zhes bya ba las skabs gnyis pa'o// //gsum pa gzhi shes la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzhi bdag med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i 'phags rgyud kyi mkhyen pa/ de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang / gnyen po gzhi shes dang gnyis/ gang zag gi sgo nas dbye na nyan thos kyi/ rang rgyal gyi/ byang sems kyi/ sangs rgyas kyi gzhi shes dang bzhi las/ dang po gnyis ni mi mthun phyogs kyi gzhi shes dang / gsum pa ni gnyen po gzhi shes yin la/ bzhi pa ni de gnyis gang yang ma yin no/ /lam gyi sgo nas dbye na mthong lamasgom lam mi slob pa'i lam gsum mo/ /mtshon byed kyi chos kyi sgo nas dbye na shes pas srid la mi gnas pa'i gzhi shes/ snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pa'i/ 'bras bu la nye ba'i/

de la ring ba'i/ mi mthun phyogs kyi/ gnyen po gzhi shes/ gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba/ sbyor ba'i mnyam nyid/ zhugs 'bras mthong lam dang dgu las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dus gsum rang bzhin med par mnyam pa nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis srid mtha' gnon nus kyi byang sems kyi mkhyen pa/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ dmigs pa med pa'i snying rjes zhi mtha' gnon nus kyi byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa/ 'di gnyis yan lag rgyas bshad du phyogs gcig tu gzhi shes kyi ngo bor bstan pas dngos bstan byang sems kyi gzhi shes kyi mtshan nyid/ thabs shes khyad par can gyis srid zhi'i mtha' gnon nus pa'i byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa/ shugs bstan theg dman gyi mtshan nyid/ thabs shes khyad par can dang bral ba'i srid zhis mtha' gnon nus min pa'i theg dman 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'bras yum sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'bras yum sgrub pa'i thabs la mi mkhas pa'i theg dman 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs/ lnga pa'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gang rung la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin gyis bcings pa'i theg dman 'phags pa'i mngon rtogs/ drug pa'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum gang rung la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i mtshan 'dzin gyis ma bcings pa'i byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa/ zhar la gzhi la mtshan 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ gzhi la dmigs yul du mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ dbye na gzhi'i chos nyid la mtshan mar 'dzin pa dang / gzhi'i chos can la mtshan mar 'dzin pa gnyis so/ /lam la mtshan 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ lam nyams len du mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ dbye na sbyin sogs la dang / byang chub phyogs mthun la nyams len du mngon pa zhen pa'i blo gnyis so/ /'bras bu la mtshan 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid/ 'bras bu thob byar mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ 'di mi mthun phyogs su sgrub pa la yul zab par bstan pa dang /

de sgrub pa la rtogs dka' bar bshad pa dang / de sgrub pa la bsam gyis mi khyab par bshad pa gsum mo/ /de dag gi gnyen po gsum las/ gzhi la mtshan 'dzin gyi gnyen po'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi la mtshan 'dzin mngon gyur 'gog pa'am sa bon spong nus pa'i byang sems kyi mkhyen pa/ de la mngon gyur 'gog pa ni byang sems kyi sbyor lam mnyam gzhag dang / ma dag sa bdun gyi rjes thob na yod cing / sa bon spong ba ni sa bcu ka'i mnyam gzhag na yod la/ des gzhan gnyis la yang 'gre'o/ /bdun pa'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi bdag med par rtogs pa'i slob rgyud kyi shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na dngos bstan byang sems kyi gzhi shes sbyor ba dang / shugs bstan theg dman gyi gzhi shes sbyor ba gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi rang bzhin med par rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis gzhi la zhen spyod mngon gyur bkag nas sgom par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba bzhi dang / gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba drug go /dang po ni gzhi'i ngo bo dang / gzhi'i khyad par dang / gzugs sogs rdzogs ma rdzogs dang / spang gnyen gyi dbye ba la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa ni mi 'gyur ba dang / byed pa po med pa dang / bya dka' rnam gsum dang / 'bras bu mi stong pa dang / srung byed gzhan la rag ma las pa dang / snang ba rnam bdun la spyod pa bkag pa'i sbyor ba'o/ /sa mtshams la mngon zhen rags pa'i gnyen po sa bdun pa man chad du yod cing / sbyor ba tsam ni sa bcu pa'i bar du yod/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi'i gnas lugs la zhen spyod dgag mi nus par gzhi bdag med par sgom pa'i theg dman slob lam pa'i mkhyen pa'o/ /brgyad pa'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi shes sbyor ba'i yul yul can la rlom pa mi dmigs par mnyam pa nyid du rtogs nas sgom pa'i byang sems kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /dgu pa la dngos bstan gyi byang sems kyi dang shugs bstan theg dman gyi mthong lam gnyis/

dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba bsgoms pas gzhi'i gnas lugs dang por mngon sum du mthong ba'i mnyam gzhag gi rgyun gyis bsdus pa gang zhig gzhi'i gnas lugs la mtha' gnyis kyi spros pa dang bral ba'i nges shes gtso bor 'dren nus pa/ dbye na byang sems kyi mthong lam sdug bsngal chos bzod nas lam la rjes shes kyi bar bcu drug dang po'i mtshan nyid/ byang sems kyi mthong lam mnyam gzhag gang zhig sdug bsngal bden pa rtag mi rtag gi spros bral la gtso bor nges pa 'dren nus/ des gzhan rnams la yang 'gre'o/ /shugs bstan theg dman gyi mthong lam gyi mtshan nyid/ gzhi gang zag gi bdag med par gsar du mngon sum du mthong ba'i mnyam gzhag gi rgyun gyis bsdus pa gang zhig spros bral la nges pa 'dren mi nus pa'o/ /zhar la sgom lam mi ston pa'i rgyu mtshan ni skabs gnyis par mthong lam gyi rjes su sgom lam bshad pa ltar/ 'dir yang ci'i phyir ma bshad ce na/ 'dir bstan pa'i mthong lam ni theg dman gyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong ba'i theg chen gyi mthong lam yin la de'i rjes su sgom lam 'chad na theg dman gyi rtogs rigs mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du goms par byed pa'i theg chen gyi sgom lam 'chad dgos pa las de med pa'i phyir ro/ /mkhyen gsum gyi mjug bsdu ba ni rab 'byor yum 'di ni chos gang ston pa'o zhes sogs don bsdu ba'i mdo tshigs gsum yod pa'i don 'dir/ de ltar 'di dang yang 'di dang / /yang 'di yin te rnam gsum mo/ /zhes gsungs pa 'di gsum gyi go rim la slob dpon gyis rgyas bshad dang mthun par bshad dgongs nas/ rnam mkhyen dang por mdzad kyang / mdo dang nyi snang gi dgongs pa ni gzhi shes dang por byed pa nyid yin zhing / chos kyi rje'i dka' 'grel las kyang de ltar du mdzad do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan gyi mtshon byed kyi chos rnams kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa sbas don rab gsal zhes bya ba las skabs gsum pa'o//

//bzhi pa rnam rdzogs sbyor ba la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ mkhyen gsum thos bsam gyis gtan la phab pa'i don rnam par bsdus nas sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas sa bcu rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ gnyis pa la/ bsgom bya'i sgo nas dbye na theg chen gzhi shes kyi sbyor ba/ lam shes kyi sbyor ba/ rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba dang gsum/ yul la spros pa gcod tshul dang yon tan gyi sgo nas dbye na mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba sogs nyi shu/ rtogs pa bskyed tshul gyi sgo nas dbye na rnam rdzogs sbyor ba/ rtse mo'i sbyor ba/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang bzhi/ mtshon byed chos kyi sgo nas dbye na bsgom bya'i rnam pa/ zhar byung sgom pa po'i gang zag yul can sbyor ba/ sbyor ba'i yon tan/ sbyor ba'i skyon/ sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ thar pa cha mthun/ nges 'byed cha mthun/ rten phyir mi ldog pa'i gang zag srid zhi mnyam nyid/ zhing dag sbyor/ thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba dang bcu gcig las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par/ 'di ni gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi gzhi min gyi/ 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'o/ /dbye na gzhi shes kyi/ lam shes kyi/ rnam mkhyen gyi shes pa'i rnam pa gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi 'phags pa'i bden bzhi'i steng gi gang zag gi bdag med dang / gzung ba chos kyi bdag med gang rung rtogs pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa/ dbye na bden pa dang po gsum gyi rnam pa bcu gnyis/ lam bden gyi rnam pa bco lnga ste nyer bdun no/ /dang po la sdug bsngal bden pa rtag par med pa dang / don dam par sdug bsngal mi skye ba dang / don gzhan gyi bdag gis dben pa dang / bdag tu lta bas mi brdzi bar rtogs pa'i rnam pa ste sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi/ don dam par sdug bsngal skyed pa'i gnas med pa dang /

nam mkha' ltar skye 'gag med pa dang / brjod rgyu'i rtog dpyod med pa dang / ming gzhi phung po med par rtogs pa ste kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi/ 'gro 'ong sogs kyis thob par byar med pa dang / sngon po sogs kyi rnam pa'i sgo nas mi 'phrog pa dang / don dam par dri ma mi zad pa dang / don dam par skye ba med par rtogs pa ste 'gog bden gyi rnam pa bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa la lam dang po'i/ lam gnyis pa'i/ lam gsum pa'i rnam pa dang gsum/ dang po la byed pa po'i bdag med pa dang / shes pa po'i bdag med pa dang / don dam par 'pho ba med pa dang / don dam par 'bri ba med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa ste bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa la gzung ba phyi rol gyi don rmi lam ltar ngo bo nyid med pa dang / sgra brnyan ltar ma skyes pa dang / mig yor ltar ma 'gags pa dang / smig rgyu'i chu ltar gzod ma nas zhi ba dang / sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid can te rang bzhin gyis mya ngan las 'das par rtogs pa ste lnga'o/ /gsum pa la kun nas nyon mongs kyi dang / rnam byang gi gzung ba rang bzhin med par rtogs pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs kyis gos pa med par rtogs pa dang / dbye ba'i spros pa med par rtogs pa dang / rang gi rtogs pa la brlam bya'i gzung ba med par rtogs pa dang / rtogs pa thob zin mi g.yo bar rtogs pa rnams te drug go /'di dag la nyan thos kyi rgyud kyi bden pa dang po gsum gyi rnam pa bcu gnyis dang / lam bden gyi lam dang po'i rnam pa bzhi ste bcu drug dang / rang rgyal gyi sgom lam rjes thob kyi lam gnyis pa'i rnam pa lnga dang / mnyam gzhag gi lam gsum pa'i rnam pa drug po rnams ni gang gi rtogs rigs su 'jog pa'i yul gyi rtogs pa dngos yin la/ byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa'i nyer bdun ni de dag gi rtogs rigs yin zhing / 'dir bstan bya'i gtso bo ni byang sems kyi rgyud la yod pa ste/

rnam rdzogs sbyor ba'i bsgom byar gyur pa'i rnam pa yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa lam shes kyi mtshan nyid/ gzhi bden bzhi'i steng gi lam gyi gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par/ dbye na kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa brgyad/ lam bden gyi rnam pa bdun/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i rnam pa lnga/ 'gog bden gyi rnam pa bcu drug ste so drug go /dang po la lam shes kyi 'dod chags dang bral bar rtogs pa'i rnam pa dang / de bzhin du lam shes kyi mi gnas pa dang / zhi ba dang / 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / nyon mongs pa dang / sems can med par rtogs pa'i rnam pa brgyad de/ dang po gsum rgyu'i rnam pa/ de nas gsum kun 'byung gi rnam pa/ de nas gcig rab skye'i rnam pa/ de nas gcig rkyen gyi rnam pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni tshad med pa dang / mtha' gnyis dang ma 'brel ba ste lam gyi rnam pa gnyis dang / tha mi dad pa dang / mchog tu 'dzin pa med pa ste rigs pa'i rnam pa gnyis dang / rnam par mi rtog pa dang / gzhal du med pa ste sgrub pa'i rnam pa gnyis dang / chad pa med pa ste nges 'byin gyi rnam pa gcig rnams so/ /gsum pa la mi rtag pa dang / sdug bsngal ba dang / stong pa dang / bdag med pa ste rang mtshan gyi rnam pa bzhi dang / de thams cad rang bzhin med pa spyi mtshan gyi rnam pa gcig rnams so/ /bzhi pa la nang dang / phyi dang / gnyis ka'i stong nyid kyi rnam pa ste 'gog pa'i rnam pa gsum dang / stong pa dang / chen po dang / don dam pa dang / 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas dang / mtha' las 'das pa dang / thog mtha' med pa dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid de zhi ba'i rnam pa brgyad dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa ste gya nom gyi rnam pa gcig dang / chos thams cad dang / rang gi mtshan nyid dang / mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa ste nges 'byung gi rnam pa bzhi'o/

/'dir rnam pa zhes pa rnams ni de dang de rtogs pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par la 'jog pa ni skabs kyi don no/ /gsum pa rnam mkhyen gyi shes rnam gyi mtshan nyid/ gzhi lam gyi steng du rnam pa'i gnas lugs mngon sum du rtogs pa mthar thug pa'i 'dzin stangs kyi khyad par/ dbye na nyan thos kyi gzhi shes dang rjes mthun gyi rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa/ byang sems kyi lam shes dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa/ sangs rgyas kyi thun mong min pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa dang gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gang zhig nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs su gyur pa/ 'di la mthun yul nyan thos kyi rtogs rigs dang / mthun chos rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa ngos gzung ba gnyis/ dang po la sde tshan bdun te/ dran pa nyer gzhag yang dag spong ba/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa/ dbang po/ stobs/ byang chub kyi yan lag 'phags pa'i lam gyi yan lag go /dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dmigs pa lus sogs la dmigs nas rnam pa rang spyi'i mtshan nyid kyis yongs su brtags te dpyod par byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na lus/ tshor ba/ sems/ chos dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ dmigs pa lus la dmigs nas zhes sogs 'gre'o/ /sa mtshams nyan thos kyi tshogs lam chung ngu nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar na yod/ tshogs lam chung ngu'i gnas skabs su ni dngos po la yongs rtog gi lam dang khyad par med do/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ dge sdig gi blang dor tshul bzhin byed pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i brtson 'grus mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gang zhig tshogs lam 'bring po yan gyis bsdus pa/ dbye na mi dge ba skyes pa yang dag par spong ba'i/ mi dge ba ma skyes pa mi skyed pa'i/ dge ba skyes pa yang dag par spel ba'i/ dge ba ma skyes pa skyed pa'i yang dag spong ba dang bzhi/

mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ mi dge ba skyes pa yang dag par spong ba la 'dun pa bskyed pa sogs lnga'i tshul gyis sgom pa'i rigs su gnas pa'i brtson 'grus mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gang zhig zhes sogs 'gre'o/ /tshogs lam 'bring po'i gnas skabs su ni rtsol ba las byung ba'i lam du 'jog pa'o/ /gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ nyes pa lnga'i gnyen por spong ba'i 'du byed brgyad bsgoms pa las byung ba'i rigs su gnas pa'i ting nge 'dzin mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa gang zhig tshogs lam chen po yan chad kyis bsdus pa/ dbye na 'dun pa'i/ brtson 'grus kyi/ sems pa'i/ shes rab kyi ting nge 'dzin rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ rdzu 'phral rkang pa gang zhig gus par sbyor ba'i 'dun pa dang mtshungs par ldan pa/ gang zhig rgyun du sbyor ba'i brtson 'grus dang mtshungs par ldan pa/ gang zhig sngon gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi bag chags dang ldan pa'i sems dang mtshungs par ldan pa/ gang zhig dmigs pa rnam par 'byed pa'i shes rab dang mtshungs par ldan pa'o/ /tshogs lam chen po'i gnas skabs su ni ting nge 'dzin yongs su sbyong ba'i lam du 'jog go /bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i sgo nas bden pa mngon par rtogs pa la dbang byed pa'i sems byung gang zhig drod rtse yan chad kyis bsdus pa/ dbye na dad pa brtson 'grus dran pa ting nge 'dzin shes rab kyi dbang po lnga/ mtshan nyid rim pa bzhin/ bden pa mngon par rtogs pa la dbang byed pa'i dbang po gang zhig bden pa la yid ches pa'i sems byung / gang zhig bden pa la spro ba'i sems byung / gang zhig bden pa'i dmigs rnam mi brjed pa'i sems byung / gang zhig bden pa la rtse gcig pa'i sems byung / gang zhig bden pa'i khyad chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa'i sems byung ngo / /drod rtse gnyis kyi skabs su ni mngon par rtogs par sbyor ba'i lam du 'jog go

/lnga pa'i mtshan nyid/ bden pa mngon par rtogs pa la dbang byed pa'i dbang po gang zhig mi mthun phyogs kyis brdzi bar mi nus pa/ dbye na dad pa/ brtson 'grus/ dran pa/ ting 'dzin/ shes rab kyi stobs dang rnam pa lnga/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ dad pa'i dbang po gang zhig mi mthun phyogs kyis brdzi bar mi nus pa zhes sogs 'gre'o/ /sa mtshams nyan thos kyi sbyor lam bzod pa nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod cing / bzod pa dang chos mchog gnyis kyi skabs su ni mngon par rtogs pa dang 'brel ba'i lam du 'jog go /drug pa'i mtshan nyid/ mthong lam du gsar du mngon du gyur pa'i yon tan gyi rigs gang zhig byang chub kyi cha shas su gyur pa/ dbye na dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag de bzhin du/ chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa dang / brtson 'grus dang / dga' ba dang / shin tu sbyangs pa dang / ting 'dzin dang / btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang bdun/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ byang chub kyi gnas kyi yan lag gang zhig shes bya ma rtogs pa rtogs par byed pa'i sems byung dang / byang chub kyi ngo bo'i yan lag gang zhig gang zag dang chos kyi bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rtog pa 'joms par byed pa'i sems byung dang / byang chub kyi nges par 'byung ba'i yan lag gang zhig mngon shes la sogs pa'i yon tan bde blag tu 'thob par byed pa'i sems byung dang / byang chub kyi phan yon gyi yan lag gang zhig chos kyi snang bas lus sems tshim par byed pa'i sems byung dang / byang chub kyi gang gis nyon mongs pa mi 'gyur bar byed pa'i yan lag gang zhig sems las su rung bar byed pa'i sems byung dang / byang chub kyi gang du kun nas nyon mongs pa mi 'gyur ba'i yan lag gang zhig bsam pa'i don thams cad 'byor par byed pa'i sems byung dang / byang chub kyi nyon mongs pa med pa'i ngo bo'i yan lag gang zhig mi mthun phyogs dang gnyen po 'dor len byed pa'i sems byung ngo /

/sa mtshams nyan thos kyi mthong lam dang sgom lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod cing / mthong lam gyi gnas skabs su ni mngon par rtogs pa'i lam du 'jog go /bdun pa'i mtshan nyid/ sgom lam du gsar du mngon du gyur pa'i yon tan gyi rigs gang zhig 'phags lam gyi cha shas su gyur pa/ dbye na yang dag pa'i lta ba dang / rtogs pa dang / ngag dang / las kyi mtha' dang / 'tsho ba dang / rtsol ba dang / dran pa dang / yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang brgyad/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ 'phags pa'i yan lag gang zhig mnyam gzhag tu rtogs pa'i de kho na nyid nges par 'dzin pa dang / gang zhig mnyam gzhag tu rtogs pa'i don ston pa'i ngag kun nas slong ba'i rgyu dus kyi kun slong dang / gang zhig gzhan gyis dris pa'i lan lung ston pa'i de dus kyi kun slong dang / gang zhig spyod pa phun sum tshogs pa/ gang zhig log 'tsho spangs te de bzhin gshegs pas ji ltar gnang ba bzhin du longs spyod par byed pa dang / gang zhig kun sbyor lhag ma rnams kyi gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa dang / gang zhig zhi gnas kyi mtshan ma ma brjed pas bying rgod sogs kyis go skabs mi 'byed pa'i sems byung dang / gang zhig mngon shes la sogs pa'i yon tan mngon par 'grub par byed pa'i sems byung ngo / /sa mtshams nyan thos kyi sgom lam nas sangs rgyas kyi sa'i bar du yod cing / sgom lam gyi skabs su ni rnam dag nges 'byin gyi lam du 'jog go /gnyis pa mthun chos rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa ngos gzung ba ni/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi byang phyogs so bdun te/ skabs 'dir bstan gyi gtso bo de nyid do/ /gnyis pa byang sems kyi lam shes dang rjes su mthun pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa'i mtshan nyid/ rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa gang zhig byang sems 'phags pa'i rtogs rigs su gyur pa/ 'di la mthun yul lam shes kyi rnam pa ngos gzung ba/ mthun chos rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa ngos gzung ba gnyis las/

dang po la sde tshan drug ste/ gnyen po'i lam/ sprul pa'i lam/ mthong chos la bder gnas kyi lam/ 'das pa'i lam/ spong ba'i lam/ sangs rgyas nyid kyi lam mo/ /'dir mtshon bya drug char gyi thog mar lam shes kyi rnam pa'i nang tshan du gyur pa'i zhes sbyar te/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ bden pa'i khyad chos mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas lta bas byas pa sogs gsum po gang rung gi gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i mngon par rtogs pa/ dbye na rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i stong pa bdag med gnyis mngon du gyur pa'i sgo nas lta bas byas pa'i gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid 'gog lam gyi rnam pa brgyad mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas lta ba'i rgyu rnam rtog gi gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ sdug bsngal bden pa'i mi rtag sdug bsngal gnyis dang kun 'byung bden pa'i rnam pa bzhi mngon sum rtogs pa'i sgo nas khams gsum po blang byar smon pa'i gnyen po'i rigs su gnas pa'o/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ gzhan don du sprul pa sna tshogs sprul pa la dbang 'byor ba'i byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ dbye na gzugs can gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ gzugs can ma yin pa gzugs la lta ba'i rnam thar/ sdug pa'i rnam thar dang gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ bsam gtan dang po'i sems la rten nas nang gzugs su 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs sna tshogs su sprul pa la gegs byed pa'i sgrib pa las rnam par grol ba'i rnam thar ro/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ nang gzugs med par 'du shes pas phyi rol gyi gzugs rnam pa sna tshogs su sprul pa la gegs byed pa'i sgrib pa las rnam par grol ba'i rnam thar ro/

/gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i sems la brten nas gzugs thams cad sdug par ro gcig tu sprul pa la gegs byed pa'i sgrib pa las rnam par grol ba'i rnam thar ro/ /gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ zhi bar gnas pa'i rang bzhin dang / thar pa dang mthun par gnas pa'i rang bzhin gang rung gis bsdus pa'i byang 'phags kyi mkhyen pa/ dbye na gzugs med kyi rnam thar bzhi/ 'gog pa'i rnam thar dang lnga/ dang po bzhi las/ nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi rnam thar gyi mtshan nyid/ gzugs med snyoms 'jug dang po gang zhig gzugs med zhi ba'i ro myong gi sgrib pa las grol ba/ des gzhan rnams la yang 'gre'o/ /'gog pa'i rnam mthar gyi mtshan nyid/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug gang zhig mi mthun phyogs kyi nyon mongs pa las grol ba'o/ /bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ zag med lam gyi rten byed pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi snyoms 'jug dbye na mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu/ dang po brgyad sngar bshad zin/ 'gog pa'i snyoms 'jug gi mtshan nyid/ dgag gzhi de bzhin nyid kyi steng du dgag bya zag bcas kyi tshor 'du bkag nas bdag med pa'i don la sems rtse gcig pa byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa'o/ /sde tshan bzhi po 'di dag gi dbye ba'i ya gyal rnams la yang mtshon bya rnams la lam shes kyi rnam pa'i nang tshan sbyar ba'i tshe/ mtshan nyid rnams la byang 'phags kyi mngon rtogs sbyar bar bya'o/ /lnga pa'i mtshan nyid/ yul bden bzhi'i chos nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas ngos skal gyi shes sgrib kyi dngos gnyen du gyur pa/ yul gyi sgo nas dbye na bzhi/ sa mtshams sa dang po nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ drug pa'i mtshan nyid/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bgrod par byed pa'i go skabs phye shul du gyur pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i mkhyen pa/ dbye na sbyin sogs phar phyin bcu'o/ /gnyis pa mthun chos rnam mkhyen gyi rnam pa ngos gzung ba ni/

sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi rnam thar sgo gsum la sogs pa so bzhi ste/ skabs 'di'i brjod bya'i gtso bo ni de nyid do/ /gsum pa sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i thugs rgyud kyi thun mong min pa'i rnam mkhyen gyi mtshan nyid/ sa bcu pa man chad las rtogs rigs phul du byung ba'i mthar thug gi mkhyen pa/ dbye na stobs/ mi 'jigs pa/ so so yang dag par rig pa/ ma 'dres pa/ de bzhin nyid/ rang byung / sangs rgyas nyid kyi rnam pa dang bdun/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ shes bya mtha' yas pa la chags thogs med par 'jug pa'i mthar thug gi mkhyen pa/ dbye na gnas dang gnas ma yin pa dang / las kyi rnam par smin pa dang / mos pa sna tshogs dang / 'jig rten gyi khams ma lus pa dang / dbang po mchog dang mchog ma yin pa dang / thams cad du 'gro ba'i lam dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang rnam par byang ba dang / sngon gnas rjes su dran pa dang / 'chi 'pho ba dang skye ba dang / zag pa zad pa mkhyen pa'i stobs bcu'i mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ rgyu 'bras kyi rab dbye ma lus pa dang / zag bcas kyi las kyi rnam smin gyi 'bras bu ma lus pa dang / sems can rnams kyi bsam sbyor 'jug pa'i tshul ma lus pa dang / 'jig rten gyi 'jig chags dang rigs la sogs pa ma lus pa dang / dbang po rno rtul sogs kyi rab dbye ma lus pa dang / byang chub gsum du bgrod pa'i lam ma lus pa dang / bsam gtan dang snyoms 'jug gi rab dbye ma lus pa dang / tshe rabs snga ma rnams kyi gnas tshul ma lus pa dang / sems can thams cad kyi gnas tshul ma lus dang / zag pa zad pa'i ngo bo dang thabs ma lus par mkhyen pa'o/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'khor gyi dbus su rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pa dam bcas pa la chos mthun gyi rgol ba med cing mi mthun pa'i rgol bas mi brdzi ba'i mkhyen pa/ dbye na rang don rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / rang don spangs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang /

gzhan don spang bya dang / gzhan don nges 'byung gi lam dam bcas pa la mi 'jigs pa'i rnam pa bzhi'i mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ 'khor gyi dbus su nga ni sangs rgyas so zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / bdag nyid kyi zag pa zad pa nyid du zhal gyis bzhes pa dang / 'dod chags sogs spang bar bya ba nyid dang / thams cad shes pa nyid la sogs pa'i lam byang chub tu nges par 'byung ba nyid du rab tu ston pa la chos mthun gyi rgol ba med cing zhes sogs sbyar/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ bshad bya dang 'chad byed thogs med du mkhyen pas 'dri ba kun la lan 'debs pa'i bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa/ dbye na chos dang / don dang / nges pa'i tshig dang / spobs pa so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ chos rnams kyi ming gi rnam grangs dang / chos rnams kyi rang spyi'i mtshan nyid dang / bshad bya yul so so'i skad dang / rdzas yod btags yod sogs kyi rab tu dbye ba thogs med mkhyen pas 'dri ba kun la lan 'debs pa'i bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i mkhyen pa'o/ /bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'phags pa gzhan dang thun mong ma yin pa'i yon tan gyi sgo nas 'gro ba'i bla mar byed pa'i mkhyen pa/ dbye na spyod pa ma 'dres pa drug rtogs pa ma 'dres pa drug phrin las ma 'dres pa gsum/ ye shes ma 'dres pa gsum ste bco brgyad do/ /lnga pa'i mtshan nyid/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug drug pa'i mtshan nyid/ chos can ji snyed pa mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug bdun pa'i mtshan nyid/ ji lta ji snyed kyi rnam pa thams cad mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa'i ye shes/ zhar byung sbyor ba sgom pa'i gang zag gi mtshan nyid/ phyi nang gi mthun rkyen khyad par can gyis yum la thos sogs kyis 'jug pa'i snod du gyur pa/ dbye na yum nyan pa'i snod/ yum gyi tshig blo la 'dzin pa'i snod/

yum gyi don mi brjed par 'dzin pa'i snod/ yum gyi don tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa'i snod dang bzhi'o/ /gnyis pa theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ shes khyad byed gsum dang ldan pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga/ gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga las/ dang po ni/ mi gnas pa'i sbyor ba dang / zhen spyod 'gog pa'i sbyor ba dang / zab pa'i dang / gting dpag dka' ba'i dang / tshad med pa'i sbyor ba rnams so/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshegs chen yun ring du rtogs pa'i dang / lung bstan thob pa dang / phyir mi ldog pa dang / nges par 'byung ba'i dang / bar chad med pa'i dang / byang chub la nye ba'i dang / myur bar byang chub pa'i dang / gzhan don gyi dang / 'phel 'grib med pa'i dang / chos dang chos min sogs mi dmigs pa'i dang / gzugs sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnam pa 'gog pa'i dang / gzugs la sogs pa'i dngos por rnam par mi rtogs pa'i dang / 'bras bu rin po che sbyin pa'i dang / rnam par dag pa'i dang / sa mtshams kyi sbyor ba rnams te/ rang bzhin gyi sbyor ba lnga ni theg chen gyi tshogs lam nas sa bcu rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ gnas skabs kyi sbyor ba bco lnga ni/ dang po theg chen gyi tshogs lam/ de nas bzhi theg chen drod sogs bzhi la rim bzhin du/ de nas gcig sa dang po/ de nas gcig sa gnyis pa nas sa bdun pa'i bar/ de nas lnga sa brgyad pa/ de nas gnyis sa dgu pa dang bcu pa gnyis la rim bzhin/ tha ma ni sa bdun man chad na yod/ gsum pa theg chen sbyor ba'i yon tan gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba sgom stobs kyis theg chen sbyor ba'i gnas skabs su thob pa'i yon tan/ dbye na bdud kyi mthu bcom pa la sogs bcu bzhi'o/ /bzhi pa theg chen sbyor ba'i skyon gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba sgom pa la bar du gcod pa'i bdud las/ dbye na rang la brten pa'i 'gal rkyen nyi shu/

mthun rkyen ma tshang ba nyer gsum/ gzhan la brten pa'i 'gal rkyen gsum ste zhe drug go /lnga pa theg chen sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid kyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi sbyor ba mtshon pa'i ched du bkod pa'i byed sgrub dang las sgrub gang rung gis bsdus pa'i/ dbye na theg chen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan/ de'i khyad mtshan/ de'i byed mtshan/ de'i ngo bo nyid mtshan dang bzhi las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen sbyor bas gzhi lam rnam pa gang rung gi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i khyad par/ dbye na gzhi shes/ lam shes rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i shes mtshan dang gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gzhi shes sbyor bas gzhi'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i khyad par/ dbye na gzhi shes sbyor ba'i yum la brten nas de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung bar shes pa la sogs pa'i shes pa bcu drug gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ lam shes sbyor bas lam gyi gnas lugs rtogs pa'i khyad par/ dbye na lam shes sbyor ba'i yum la brten nas rnam thar sgo gsum rtogs pa la sogs pa'i shes pa bcu drug gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ rnam mkhyen sbyor bas rnam pa'i gnas lugs rtogs pa'i khyad par/ dbye na rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i yum la brten nas mthong chos la bder gnas shes pa la sogs pa'i shes pa bcu drug khyad mtshan gyi mtshan nyid/ rang gang la ldan pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor ba de theg dman gyi lam las khyad par du 'phags par mtshon nus pa'i theg chen sbyor ba'i khyad par byed chos/ dbye na chos nyid rtog ge'i blos bsam du med pa la sogs pa'i khyad par bcu drug byed mtshan gyi mtshan nyid/ theg chen sbyor bas gzhan don byed pa'i char gyur pa'i mdzad pa phrin las/ dbye na gzhi shes lam shes rnam mkhyen sbyor ba'i byed mtshan dang gsum/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ de dang des gzhan don sgrub pa'i char gyur pa'i mdzad pa phrin las/ dbye na dang po la gzhi shes sbyor bas gdul bya la phan par sgrub pa sogs byed pa gsum/

gnyis pa la lam shes sbyor bas gdul bya'i skyabs mgon mdzad pa la sogs pa'i byed pa bdun/ gsum pa la rnam mkhyen sbyor bas rten gyi mdzad pa ste gcig tu nges so/ /ngo bo nyid mtshan gyi mtshan nyid/ shes khyad byed gsum gyis mtshon par bya ba'i gzhir gyur pa'i theg chen gyi sbyor ba'i las sgrub/ dbye na gzhi shes lam shes rnam mkhyen gyi sbyor ba'i ngo bo nyid mtshan dang gsum/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ de dang de'i shes khyad byed gsum gyis mtshon par bya ba'i gzhir gyur pa'i de dang de'i las sgrub/ dbye na dang po la nyon mongs pas dben pa'i ngo bo nyid sogs bzhi/ gnyis pa la bya dka' ba'i ngo bo nyid sogs lnga/ gsum pa la dmigs pa'i ngo bo nyid sogs bdun no/ /drug pa skabs 'dir dngos bstan gyi theg chen gyi thar pa cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ mtshan med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi sgo nas rnam mkhyen sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i thar pa cha mthun/ dbye na gnyis te/ yul gyi sgo nas dbye na bden pa mngon par rtogs pa la dbang byed pa'i dad sogs dbang po maṃ yiṃn pa rnam par byang ba tsam la dbang byed pa'i dad pa'i/ brtson 'grus/ dran pa/ ting nge 'dzin/ shes rab kyi dbang po dang lnga/ dang po ni sangs rgyas sogs kyi yul la mkhas pa'i sems byung / gnyis pa ni sbyin sogs kyi yul la mkhas pa'i sems byung / gsum pa ni bsam pa phun sum tshogs pa sems bskyed la mkhas pa'i sems byung / bzhi pa ni rnam par mi rtog pa la mkhas pa'i sems byung / lnga pa ni chos thams cad kyi rnam pa thams cad yongs su shes pa la mkhas pa'i sems byung ngo / /dbang po'i sgo nas dbye na dad sogs dbang rnon dang dbang rtul gnyis/ dang po ni theg pa gzhan gyis bar ma chod par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob sla ba'i dad sogs so/ /gnyis pa ni de dka' ba'i dad sogs so/ /shugs bstan rang rgyal gyi thar pa cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/

gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi sgo nas rang rgyud la rang rgyal gyi byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i thar pa cha mthun/ shugs bstan nyan thos kyi thar pa cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ gang zag gi bdag med rtogs pa'i sgo nas rang rgyud la nyan thos kyi byang chub sgrub pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i thar pa cha mthun/ bdun pa 'dir bstan gyi theg chen gyi nges 'byed cha mthun gyi mtshan nyid/ dmigs pa sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa'i rjes thob kyis bsdus pa'i sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i byang sems so skye'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa/ dbye na 'dir bstan theg chen gyi drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog bzhi/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ dmigs pa sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa sems mnyam pa nyid sogs bcu po gang rung gis bsdus pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun/ dbye na drod chung 'bring chen po gsum/ dmigs pa 'dra ba las rnam pa dang po ni/ mnyam pa dang / byams pa'i sems gnyis/ gnyis pa ni phan pa'i sems la sogs pa gsum/ gsum pa ni pha dang ma'i sems la sogs pa lnga/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ dmigs pa sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa rang gzhan dge sdig gi blang dor la sbyor ba sogs gsum gyis bsdus pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun/ dbye na rtse mo chung 'bring chen po gsum/ dmigs pa gsum 'dra ba las rnam pa dang po ni/ rang gzhan mi dge ba spong ba la sbyor ba/ gnyis pa ni rang gzhan dge ba sgrub pa la sbyor ba/ gsum pa ni rang gzhan stongaṃ nyidaṃ sgoṃm pa la sbyor ba/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ dmigs pa sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa rang gzhan bden pa shes pa la sbyor ba sogs gsum gyis bsdus pa'i nges byed cha mthun/ dbye na bzod pa chung 'bring chen po gsum/ dmigs pa 'dra ba las rnam pa dang po ni rang gzhan bden pa shes pa la sbyor ba/ gnyis pa ni rang gzhan rgyun zhugs kyi 'bras bu shes pa la mngon du bya ba'i phyir sbyor ba/

gsum pa ni rang gzhan byang sems skyon med pa la sbyor ba'o/ /bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ dmigs pa sems can la dmigs nas rnam pa rang gzhan smin grol sogs la sbyor ba sogs gsum gyis bsdus pa'i nges 'byed cha mthun/ dbye na chos mchog chung 'bring chen po gsum/ dmigs pa 'dra ba las rnam pa dang po ni rang gzhan dge rtsa smin grol la sbyor ba/ gnyis pa ni/ rang gzhan mngon shes khyad par can la sbyor ba/ gsum pa ni rang gzhan rnam mkhyen gyi ye shes bskyed pa la sbyor ba'o/ /brgyad pa slob pa phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs kyi mtshan nyid/ stong nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i ye shes skyes pa'i stobs kyis gnas skabs bla med rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog pa'i byang sems/ dbye na sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam la gnas pa'i phyir mi ldog pa'i dge 'dun gsum/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin sbyor mthong sgom gsum la gnas pa'i gang zag gang zhig gnas skabs bla med rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog pa'o/ /phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan tshigs kyi mtshan nyid/ stong nyid la sgom byung gtso bor gyur pa'i stobs kyis thob pa'i yon tan gang zhig rang gang la ldan pa'i byang sems gnas skabs rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog par sgrub nus pa/ dbye na sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam la gnas pa'i byang sems phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan tshigs gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang gang la ldan pa'i sbyor lam la gnas pa'i byang sems gnas skabs rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog par sgrub nus pa/ dbye na drod/ rtse mo/ bzod pa/ chos mchog la gnas pa'i byang sems phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan tshigs bzhi mtshan nyid snga mas 'gre/ dbye na dang po la bcu gcig gnyis pa la drug gsum pa la gnyis/ bzhi pa la gcig ste nyi shu'o/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang gang la ldan pa'i mthong lam la gnas pa'i byang sems gnas skabs rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog par sgrub nus pa/

dbye na shes bzod skad cig ma bcu drug gi ming can gyi gtan tshigs bcu drug go /gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang gang la ldan pa'i sgom lam la gnas pa'i byang sems gnas skabs rdzogs byang las phyir mi ldog par sgrub nus pa'o/ /'di la sgom lam gtan la dbab pa dang / rtags kyi don dngos gnyis las/ dang po la sgom lam gyi khyad par byed chos/ khyad gzhi sgom lam gyi ngo bo/ sgom lam gyi dbye ba dang gsum/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ zab mo'i stong pa nyid mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du goms pa'i sgo nas theg dman gyi sgom lam las khyad par byed chos su gyur pa/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi sbyor lam mthong lam sgom lam gsum mnyam gzhag gi gnas skabs su mthong zin gyi don la sems 'jal rtog gsum byed pa'i byang sems 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi mkhyen pa/ mtshon bya gnyis la skabs 'dir bstan dang / theg chen sbyar zhing / gong gi sbyor mthong sgom gsuṃm gyi dang phyir mi ldog pa'i gtan tshigs gsum gyi gang zhig gsum la theg chen sbyor lam pa'i rgyud kyi yon tan zhes sogs sbyar ro/ /gsum pa la dngos dang rtsod pa spong ba gnyis/ dang po la theg chen gyi sgom lam chung ngu'i chung ngu la sogs dgu'o/ /gnyis pa la grangs nges pa dang / byed las la rtsod pa spang ba gnyis/ dang po la rtsod pa ni/ theg chen sgom lam chos can/ dgur grangs ma nges par thal/ 'bras bu dgu las mang ba yod pa'i phyir te/ 'bras bu bsod nams grangs med gzhal med sogs skyed pa'i phyir zhe na/ lan la gnyis/ don dam gyi lan ni theg chen gyi sgom lam chos can/ don dam par dgu las mang bar thal/ don dam par 'bras bu bsod nams grangs med gzhal med sogs skyed pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur chos can/ khyod dbu ma pa la gnod byed kyi thal 'gyur yang dag ma yin par thal/ dbu ma pas khyod la rtags ma grub kyi lan don mthun du thebs pa'i phyir/

kun rdzob kyi lan ni theg chen gyi sgom lam chos can/ kun rdzob tu dgu las mang bar thal/ kun rdzob tu 'bras bu bsod nams grangs med sogs skyed pa'i phyir zhes pa'i thal 'gyur chos can/ khyod dbu ma pa la gnod byed kyi thal 'gyur yang dag min par thal/ dbu ma pas khyod la khyab pa ma nges pa'i lan don mthun du thebs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la gnyis te/ gnas skabs kyi byed las la rtsod pa spang ba dang / mthar thug gi byed las la rtsod pa spang ba'o/ /dang po la rtsod pa ni theg chen gyi sgom lam chos can/ spang gnyen nyams 'phel gyi bya ba mi byed par thal/ don dam par zab mo stong nyid kyi ngo bo yin pa'i phyir zhe na/ lan ni/ de chos can/ don dam par zab mo stong pa nyid kyi ngo bo yin kyang kun rdzob tu spang gnyen nyams 'phel sogs kyi bya ba byed pa 'thad de/ de ltar byed pa rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/ dper na sku gsum po de don dam par gzung 'dzin spros pa dang bral yang kun rdzob tu gzung 'dzin spros par bstan pa'i sgo nas gdul bya'i don mdzad pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa la rtsod pa ni/ byang sems sgom lam pa'i rgyud kyi sems bskyed chos can/ khyod kyis bla na med pa'i byang chub mi skyed par thal/ khyod kyi skad cig re re kho nas bla na med pa'i byang chub mi skyed/ khyod kyi skad cig snga phyi lhan cig tshogs pa dang rim gyis 'byung bas kyang mi skyed pa'i phyir/ gtan tshigs phyi ma grub ste/ khyod kyi skad cig phyi ma de byung ma thag tu snga ma de rjes su 'byung ba med pa nyid du 'jig pa'i phyir zhe na/ lan ni/ de chos can/ khyod kyi skad cig phyi ma de byung ma thag tu snga ma de rjes su 'byung ba med pa nyid du 'jig kyang khyod kyi skad cig snga phyi rim gyis 'byung bas bla na med pa'i byang chub bskyed pa 'thad de/ de ltar 'byung ba rten 'brel gyi chos nyid yin pa'i phyir/

dper na mar me'i skad cig phyi ma de byung ma thag tu snga ma de rjes su 'gro ba med pa nyid du 'jig kyang skad cig snga phyi phan tshun ltos nas sdong bu snum ldan bsreg pa 'thad pa bzhin no/ /gnyis pa rtags kyi don dngos la brgyad de/ skye ba zab pa dang / de bzhin du 'gag pa dang / de bzhin nyid dang / shes bya dang / shes pa dang / spyod pa dang / gnyis su med pa dang / thabs la mkhas pa zab pa rnams so/ /'di dag la yang rjes thob lus ngag gi spyod pa dang / mnyam gzhag gi rtogs pa gnyis gnyis yod do/ /dgu pa srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor ba la mtshan nyid dang klan ka spang ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes la dbang sgyur thob pa'i sgo nas srid zhi mnyam pa nyid du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ sa mtshams dag pa sa gsum na yod do/ /gnyis pa la rtsa 'grel gnyis kar dngos su bstan pa'i las med par thal ba'i klan ka spang ba sogs kyi sgras bstan pa lan ma nges par thal ba'i klan ka spang ba/ lung dang 'gal ba'i klan ka spang ba/ ha cang thal ba'i klan ka spang ba dang bzhi'o/ /bcu pa zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ rang snang la snod bcud thams cad dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig tu 'char ba'i ched du ma dag pa'i snod bcud kyi zhing sbyong bar byed pa'i dag sa'i rnal 'byor/ dbye na bcud kyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba dang / snod kyi zhing dag pa'i sbyor ba gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang snang la bcud kyi zhing thams cad dag pa rab 'byams 'ba' zhig tu 'char ba'i ched du ma dag pa'i bcud kyi zhing sbyong bar byed pa'i dag sa'i rnal 'byor/ des phyi ma la rigs 'gre'o/ /sa mtshams snga ma dang 'dra/ bcu gcig pa thabs mkhas sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ sher phyin gyi don bcu po mngon du bya ba'i dus dang dus min pa shes nas dus la ma babs na mngon du mi byed cing / dus la babs na mngon du byed pa'i dag sa'i rnal 'byor/

dbye na bar chad kyi chos las brgal ba'i/ mi gnas par gnas pa'i/ gzhan don sngon gyi smon lam gyis 'phangs pa'i/ thun mong min pa'i/ ma chags pa'i/ mi dmigs pa'i/ mtshan ma med pa'i/ smon pa med pa'i/ phyir mi ldog pa'i rtags kyi/ tshad med pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i sbyor ba dang bcu/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ bar chad kyi chos las brgal ba'i sher phyin mngon du bya ba'i dus dang dus min pa shes nas dus la ma babs pa na mngon du mi byed cing / dus la babs pa na mngon du byed pa'i dag sa'i rnal 'byor/ des phyi ma rnams la rigs 'gre/ sa mtshams snga ma dang 'dra/ thabs mkhas dang po'i skabs su lha'i bu'i bdud/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud/ phung po'i bdud/ 'chi bdag gi bdud bzhi'i mtshan nyid rim pa bzhin/ bdud gzhan gsum las 'das pa'i dge ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'dod lha'i rigs su gtogs pa dang / sems rab tu ma zhi bar byed pa'i nyon mongs pa dang / sems can gyi rgyud kyis bsdus pa'i gzugs kyi phung po dang / rang dbang med par srog 'gag par byed pa'i las rnams so/ /bcom pa'i sa mtshams la theg dman gyi dbang du byas na mthong lam nas lha'i bu'i bdud bcom/ lhag bcas myang 'das thob nas nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom/ lhag med myang 'das thob nas phung po'i bdud bcom/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rab mtha' thob nas 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom/ theg chen gyi dbang du byas nas sa mtshams sbyor lam nas lha'i bu'i bdud bcom/ sa dang po nas nyon mongs pa'i bdud dang / 'chi bdag gi bdud/ sa brgyad pa nas phung po'i bdud bcom/ sbas don rab gsal las skabs bzhi pa'i yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o// //lnga pa rtse sbyor la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ mkhyen gsum bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ de la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na sbyor lam mthong lam sgom lam rtse sbyor dang gsum/ mtshon byed chos kyi sgo nas dbye na/

rtags kyi/ rnam 'phel gyi/ brtan pa'i/ sems kun gnas kyi/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor/ bsal bya log sgrub dang brgyad/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rtse sbyor gyi rtags bcu gnyis gang rung thob pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi drod nas sa bcu'i rgyun mtha'i bar du yod/ des gzhan rnams la 'gre'o/ /drod kyi rtse sbyor gyi mtshan nyid/ drod kyi ngo bor gyur pa'i bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ rtse sbyor gyi bsod nams rnam par 'phel tshul bcu drug po gang rung thob pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi sbyor lam rtse mo nas sa bcu'i rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ rtse sbyor gyi don gnyis brtan pa thob pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi bzod pa nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ bsod nams mang pos mtshon nas bstan pa'i rtse sbyor gyi ting nge 'dzin thob pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ sa mtshams theg chen gyi chos mchog nas rgyun mtha'i bar na yod/ lnga pa la spang bya rtog pa dang / gnyen po mthong lam rtse sbyor gnyis/ dang po la skabs 'dir dngos bstan gyi mthong spang 'jug pa gzung rtog ldog pa gzung rtog rdzas 'dzin rtog pa/ btags 'dzin rtog pa dang bzhi/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ mthong spang du gyur pa'i shes sgrib gang zhig rang yul theg chen gyi chos la dmigs nas blang bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ dbye na byang sems lam gyi ngo bo sogs la blang bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa dgu'o/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang yul theg dman gyi chos la dmigs nas dor bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ dbye na rtog pa dman pa sogs la dor bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa dgu'o/ /gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang yul longs spyod pa po la dmigs nas 'dzin pa por bden par mngon par zhen pa'i blo/

dbye na 'dzin 'dor byas pa'i sher phyin sogs la dmigs nas 'dzin pa por bden par mngon par zhen pa dgu'o/ /bzhi pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang yul longs spyod pa po la dmigs nas 'dzin pa por btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa'i blo/ dbye na ched bzhin nges par mi 'byung ba sogs la dmigs nas 'dzin pa por btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa dgu'o/ /gnyis pa gnyen po mthong lam rtse sbyor la zhar las byung ba'i don dang / rnal ma mthong lam rtse sbyor dngos gnyis/ dang po la byang chub chen po'i rgyu dang / skabs 'dir bstan gyi byang chub chen po dngos gnyis/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ rang 'bras theg chen gyi mthong lam bskyed pa'i rgyu tshogs su gyur pa/ dbye na gzhan 'bras bu rtogs pa'i chos la 'god pa dang / rgyu lung gi chos la 'god pa dang / rang nyid byang chen thob byed kyi bar chad med pa'i rgyu dang gsum/ gnyis pa la gsum ste/ dbu ma pa'i byang chen 'dod tshul ngos gzung ba/ dngos smra ba'i byang chen 'dod tshul dgag pa/ grol bar 'dod pas stong nyid la 'jug par gdams pa'o/ /dang po la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ dri ma gdod ma nas zad pa dang / mi bskyed par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sgo nas mthar thug gi skyabs gnas su gyur pa/ gnyis pa la sku gsum mo/ /gnyis pa dngos smra ba'i byang chub 'dod tshul dgag pa la gnyis te/ dngos stobs kyi rigs pas dang / khas blangs dang 'gal bas dgag pa'o/ /dang po ni/ theg chen gyi mthong lam chos can/ khyod dri ma gdod ma nas yod pa gnyen pos gsar du zad pa dang / dri ma gdod nas yod pa gnyen pos skye 'phro bcad pa'i tshul gyis mi skye bar mngon sum tu rtogs pa'i sgo nas byang chub tu 'jog par min par thal/ dri ma gdod ma nas ma grub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ dngos smra ba chos can/ dri ma bden par grub pa dang / ston pa sangs rgyas kyis dri ma zad par spangs par khas blangs pa gnyis po de khas blangs nang 'gal ba yin te/

dri ma bden par grub na/ dri ma gnyen pos spong du mi rung bas khyab pa'i phyir/ 'o na khyod kyi lugs la dri ma gnyen pos ji ltar spong zhe na/ rnal 'byor sa bzhis rim gyis spong ba las/ 'di la rnal 'byor gyi sa bzhi'i mtshan nyid/ sa mtshams/ grangs nges pa/ go rim nges pa dang bzhi las/ dang po bdag med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa'i mtshan nyid/ chos thams cad bdag med par rtogs pa'i lta ba bskyed pa'i ched du phung po la gang zag gi bdag med par sgom par byed pa'i theg chen gyi tshogs lam gyis bsdus pa'i mngon par rtogs pa/ gzung med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa'i mtshan nyid/ gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i don la gsal snang thob pa'i byang sems kyi drod rtse gang rung gis bsdus pa'i mngon par rtogs pa/ 'dzin med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa'i mtshan nyid/ 'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa'i don la gsal snang thob pa'i bzod mchog gang rung gis bsdus pa'i mngon par rtogs pa/ spros bral rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor gyi sa'i mtshan nyid/ chos thams cad spros pa'i mtha' bzhi dang bral bar mngon sum du rtogs pa'i ye shes gang zhig rang gi ngos skal gyi shes sgrib kyi spong gnyen du gyur pa/ gnyis pa la/ dang po ni theg chen gyi tshogs lam du bsgom par bya ba yin te/ der chos kyi bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba la 'jug pa dang / nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba rnam par gnon pa'i phyir du sgom dgos pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni theg chen gyi drod rtse gang rung du bsgom par bya ba yin te/ der gzung ba rang bzhin med pa'i don la gsal snang lhag pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni theg chen gyi bzod mchog gnyis su bsgom par bya ba yin te/ der 'dzin pa rang bzhin med pa'i don la gsal snang lhag pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni theg chen gyi mthong lam nas bsgom par bya ba yin te/ der gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog gi sa bon gyi dngos gnyen du bsgom par bya ba yin pa'i phyir/

gsum pa ni/ rnal 'byor gyis de la bzhir grangs nges te/ yul bdag med la ltos nas kyang bzhir grangs nges/ spang bya sgrib pa la ltos nas kyang bzhir grangs nges pa'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ yul bdag med la gang zag gi bdag med dang chos kyi bdag med gnyis las/ phyi ma la bden pa bkag tsam gyi chos kyi bdag med dang / mtha' bzhi'i spros pa dang bral ba'i chos kyi bdag med gnyis/ dang po la yang gzung ba phyi rol gyi don la bden pa bkag tsam gyi chos kyi bdag med dang / 'dzin pa la bden pa bkag tsam gyi chos kyi bdag med gnyis su 'dus pa'i phyir/ rtsa ba'i gtan tshigs phyi ma der thal/ spang bya sgrib pa la shes sgrib dang nyon sgrib gnyis las/ dang po la mngon gyur ba dang sa bon gnyis/ mngon gyur ba la gzung rtog mngon gyur ba dang 'dzin rtog mngon gyur ba gnyis su yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba de dang por sgom dgos te/ phung po la dmigs nas ngar 'dzin pa'i blo de nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba yin pas dang por 'gog dgos pa'i phyir/ de'i 'og tu gzung med rtogs pa'i lta ba dang 'dzin med rtogs pa'i lta ba gnyis rim bzhin sgom dgos te/ de gnyis ma skyed par shes sgrib spong mi nus pa'i phyir te/ de gnyis kyis rim bzhin gzung 'dzin gyi don la bden par 'dzin pa de 'gog dgos pa'i phyir/ de'i 'og tu spros bral rtogs pa'i lta ba sgom dgos te/ shes sgrib kyi sa bon spang ba la/ theg chen thun mong ma yin pa'i rtogs rigs dgos pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grol bar 'dod pas stong pa nyid la 'jug par gdams pa ni/ 'o na dngos po rang bzhin du yod pa'i phyogs kyi shes sgrib kyi gnyen po ji ltar sgom zhe na/ 'di la gang la blta ba'i yul/ ji ltar blta ba'i tshul/ lta ba sgom pa'i byed pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzugs sogs kun rdzob pa'i ngo bo 'di la'o/

/gnyis pa ni tha snyad du med do zhes skur pa 'debs pa dang / don dam du yod do zhes sgro 'dogs pa bsal nas rang bzhin med par lta ba'o/ /gsum pa ni bsal gzhag spangs te rang bzhin med par sgoms pa sa de kho na nyid mthong la/ des sgrib pa las grol bar 'gyur te/ dngos 'dzin gyi phyin ci log ldog par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa rnal ma mthong lam rtse sbyor dngos la gnyis te/ bar chad med lam dang / khyad par gyi lam mo/ /dang po la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sbyin sogs phar phyin re re'i nang du phar phyin lnga lnga tshang ba'i nyams len mngon du gyur pa'i sgo nas mthong spang gi dngos gnyen byed pa'i bar chad med lam/ gnyis pa ni/ skad cig ma'i grangs kyi sgo nas dbye ba med de/ 'di rnams sdug bsngal chos bzod skad cig ma gcig tu 'du ba'i phyir ro/ /spang bya'i sgo nas dbye na slob dpon gyi lugs la mthong spang 'jug pa gzung rtog dang / rdzas 'dzin rtog pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i sbyor ba nyer bsdogs gnyis/ ldog pa gzung rtog dang / btags 'dzin rtog pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i bar chad med lam gnyis te/ lus rnam gzhag tu/ mthong zhes bya ba'i lam la ni/ /rnam rtog rnam pa bzhi dang ni/ /zhes pa'i don du bzhed do/ /'o na sbyor 'jug gnyis kyi khyad par gang zhe na/ sbyor lam chos mchog chen po'i ye shes la sbyor ba nyer bsdogs kyi lam dang / mthong lam bar chad med lam la 'jug pa bar chad med lam gnyis su phye ba slob dpon gyi dgongs pa yin kyang / rtsa ba'i dgongs pa la 'byor pa shin tu dka' ste/ 'di bzhi char mthong lam rtse sbyor yin pa'i phyir ro/ /yang mthong spang rtog pa bzhi la yul gyi dbye bas dgu bzhi sum cu so drug de nyid la khams gsum gyi dbye bas brgya rtsa brgyad du yod pas de dag spong ba'i cha nas mthong lam rtse sbyor la brgya rtsa brgyad du dbye ba yang gsungs so/

/gnyis pa khyad par gyi lam la/ mnyam gzhag ye shes/ rjes thob ye shes/ dang po la mthong lam khyad par lam gyi ngo bor gyur pa'i seng ge rnam bsgyings kyi mtshan nyid/ mthong lam rnam grol lam gyi rjes mnyam gzhag las ma langs par rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu la lugs mthun dang lugs ldog tu snyoms par 'jug pa'i gnas skabs kyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ 'di dang sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings gnyis don mi gcig ste/ sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings ni rjes thob rten 'brel la rtogs pa'i rjes su 'byung ba yin la/ 'di ni de'i snga rol du 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la rtog bya rten 'brel/ ji ltar rtog pa'i tshul/ de la rtog pa'i dgos pa dang gsum las/ dang po la yan lag bcu gnyis yod pa las/ dang po ma rig pa ni/ yul mi gsal ba'i rnam pas 'jug pa'i sems byung gang zhig 'du byed kun slong du gyur pa/ 'du byed ni ma rig pas kun nas bslangs te yang srid 'phen par byed pa'i zag bcas kyi las so/ /rnam par shes pa ni 'bras bu'i cha gzung na las la brten nas skye gnas su dang por grub pa'i rnam shes/ rgyu'i cha bzung na las kyi bag chags yongs su 'dzin par byed pa'o/ /ming dang gzugs ni nying mtshams sbyor ba'i skad cig gnyis par phung po lnga grub pa'o/ /skye mched ni ming gzugs yongs su smin pa las mig sogs tshang bar dod pa'o/ /reg pa ni skye mched drug yul dang 'phrad pa las yul gyi 'gyur ba yongs su gcod par byed pa'i sems byung ngo / /tshor ba ni reg pas yongs su bcad pa bzhin rnam smin nyams su myong ba'i sems byung ngo / /sred pa ni tshor ba bde sdug la blang dor du chags pa'i sems byung ngo / /len pa ni tshor ba'i rgyu yongs su 'tshol ba la 'dun pa'i 'dod chags so/ /srid pa ni rgyu 'bras cha gcig pa ltar na sngar gyi sred pas gsos btab nas las kyi bag chags nus pa mthu can tu gyur pa'o/

/cha gnyis pa ltar na yang srid 'phen byed kyi las gsar du gsog pa'i gnas skabs so/ /skye ba ni ma'i mngal nas phung po lnga rim gyis grub pa'o/ /rga shi ni na tshod dang srog yongs su 'gyur ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ma rig pa'i rkyen gyis 'du byed rnams so zhes bya ba la sogs pa kun nyon lugs dang mthun pa dang / des 'phangs pa'i ma rig pa 'gags pas 'du byed 'gag zhes sogs rnam byang lugs dang mthun pa dang / des 'phangs pa'i rga shi gang las byung zhes sogs kun nyon lugs dang mi mthun pa dang / skye ba 'gags pas rga shi 'gag pa sogs rnam byang lugs dang mi mthun pa la rtog go /gsum pa ni/ 'khor ba rgyu 'bras sdug kun gyi bden pa la mkhas pa'i phyir kun nyon lugs mthun dang lugs ldog dang / myang 'das rgyu 'bras 'gog lam gyi bden pa la mkhas pa'i phyir rnam byang lugs mthun lugs ldog sgom par byed de/ 'di ltar kun nyon lugs mthun du bsgoms pas sdug bsngal gyi bden pa rtogs par 'gyur te/ rgyu las nyon gyi rnam smin mthar thug pa rga shir rtogs pa'i phyir/ kun nyon lugs ldog bsgoms pas kun 'byung gi bden pa rtogs par 'gyur te/ sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba las nyon du rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ /rnam byang lugs mthun bsgoms pas ni 'gog bden rtogs par 'gyur te/ ma rig pa sogs yan lag snga ma snga ma rnams 'gags pas rga shi 'gags par rtogs pa'i phyir ro/ rnam byang lugs ldog bsgoms pas lam bden rtogs te/ rga shi 'gags par ni yan lag snga ma rnams 'gags pa la ltos la de yang 'gog byed kyi lam la rag las par shes pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa sgom lam rtse sbyor la gsum ste/ rten sgom lam/ spang bya rnam rtog brten pa yon tan no/ /dang po la sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings/ dngos gzhi thod rgal gnyis las/ dang po ni/ de'i mtshan nyid/ rjes thob rten 'brel la rtog pa'i rjes su dngos gzhi thod rgal gyi ched du mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu la chos gzhan ma spel bar lugs mthun dang lugs ldog tu snyoms par 'jug pa'i gnas skabs kyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/

gnyis pa la/ dngos gzhi thod rgal chung 'bring chen po gsum la/ mtshan nyid/ snyoms par 'jug pa'i dgos pa/ thob pa'i sa mtshams dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rim bzhin/ sbyor ba seng ge rnam bsgyings sngon du song nas/ dngos gzhi thod rgal 'bring po'i ched du mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu la chos gzhan ma spel bar lugs mthun kho nar snyoms par 'jug pa'i gnas skabs kyi sems dpa'i rnal 'byor dang / dngos gzhi thod rgal chung ngu sngon du song nas/ dngos gzhi thod rgal chen po'i ched du 'gog pa spel ba'i rigs su gnas pa'i snyoms 'jug dang / mtshams 'dzin gyi 'dod sems kyi rjes su snyoms 'jug dgu la 'dod sems re re spel nas lugs ldog tu 'jug pa'i gnas skabs kyi theg chen gyi rjes la thob pa'i mngon rtogs so/ /gnyis pa ni/ sa bdun pa man chad du dbang thob pa'i ched du 'jug la/ sa brgyad pa yan chad du de mthar phyin pa'i ched du 'jug go /gsum pa ni/ sa gnyis pa nas thob ste/ 'phags pa dkon mchog sprin dang sdud pa las bskal pa grangs med pa gnyis kyis nges par 'byung ba'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams thod rgal la snyoms par 'jug par bshad pa gang zhig sa gnyis pa nas bskal pa grangs med pa gnyis kyis nges par 'byung bar bya ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa spang bya rnam rtog la theg chen gyi sgom spang rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid/ chos nyid mngon sum du mthong zin rgyun ldan du goms par byed pa'i lam gyi spong bar bya ba'i zhen blo/ dbye ba la slob dpon gyi dang / 'phags pa'i lugs gnyis las/ dang po la sgom spang gzung 'dzin rtog pa gnyis/ dang po la sgom spang 'jug pa dang sgom spang ldog pa gzung rtog gnyis las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ theg chen gyi sgom spang rtog pa gang zhig rang yul la 'jug bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa/ dbye na ston pas chos mdor bsdus te gsungs pa la dmigs nas mngon par zhen pa sogs dgu/

gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig rang yul la ldog bya'i gzung bar mngon par zhen pa/ dbye na byang chub kyi sems mi skye ba la dmigs nas gzung bar mngon par zhen pa sogs dgu'o/ /gnyis pa la sgom spang rdzas 'dzin rtog pa dang / sgom spang btags 'dzin rtog pa gnyis las/ dang po'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig longs spyod pa po la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por mngon par zhen pa/ dbye na sems can du btags pa la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por mngon par zhen pa sogs dgu'o/ /gnyis pa'i mtshan nyid/ gang zhig longs spyod pa po la dmigs nas der btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa/ dbye na rnam mkhyen la sgrib pa'i sgom spang la dmigs nas longs spyod pa por btags pa tsam du mngon par zhen pa sogs dgu'o/ /gnyis pa 'phags pa'i lugs la/ sgom spang gzung rtog dang / sgom spang 'dzin rtog gnyis las/ dang po la sbyor ba'i yul can gyi gzung rtog dang / 'jug pa'i yul can gyi gzung rtog gnyis/ phyi ma la sems can tu btags pa la brten pa'i 'dzin rtog dang / btags pa'i rgyu mtshan la brten pa'i 'dzin rtog gnyis su bzhed pa ni rtsa ba'i dgongs pa ste/ sbyor ba'i rnam pa'i spyod yul can/ /zhes dang / 'jug pa'i yul can yin bzhed de/ /zhes dang / sems can gyi dang de rgyu yi/ /yul can zhes gsungs pa'i phyir dang / mthong spang rtog pa la 'jug pa gzung rtog sogs thun mong ma yin pa'i ming bzhi yod pa ltar 'di la yang nges par dgos shing / dgos pa ltar gzhung na snang ngo / /gsum pa yon tan ni/ sgom spang gzung 'dzin gyi rnam par rtog pa brgya rtsa brgyad kyi sa bon spangs pas theg pa gsum gyi rtogs rigs phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgya mtsho chen po la chu bo bzhi 'du ba bzhin du 'ong ba'i rnam pas brten pa'i sgom lam chen po'i chen po la gnas pa'i byang sems kyi rgyud kyi yon tan no/ /bdun pa bar chad med pa'i rtse sbyor la ngo bo dang /

dmigs rnam gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang gi dngos 'bras su gyur pa'i rnam mkhyen bskyed pa la chos gzhan gyi bar ma chod pa'i bsdus sgom rab tu gyur pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ gnyis pa la chos thams cad bden pa'i dngos po med pa de chos can/ bar chad med rtse'i dmigs rkyen yin te/ de khyod la dmigs nas skye ba'i phyir/ rgyun mtha' man chad kyi mkhyen gsum gyi dmigs rnam ma brjed pa'i dran pa de chos can/ bar chad med rtse'i bdag rkyen yin te/ de rang dbang du skyed byed yin pa'i phyir/ bar chad med rtse'i rnam pa chos can/ zhi ba nyid yin te/ spros bral gyi rnam pa can yin pa'i phyir/ brgyad pa bsal bya log sgrub la gnyis te/ bsal bya dang / sel byed do/ /dang po la bsal bya log rtog dang / des kun nas bslangs pa'i klan ka gnyis las/ dang po ni/ don dam rgyu mtshan du byas nas kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag mi 'thad snyam du 'dzin pa dang / kun rdzob rgyu mtshan du byas nas don dam gyi rnam gzhag mi 'thad snyam du 'dzin pa'i log rtog gnyis dang / gnyis pa la kun rdzob sgo can dang / don dam sgo can gyi klan ka gnyis/ de yang kun rdzob rtags su bkod pa'i klan ka dang / don dam rtags su bkod pa'i klan ka gnyis rim bzhin kun rdzob sgo can dang don dam sgo can gyi klan ka yin zhing / dang po la kun rdzob rigs mthun gyi dang / de rigs mi mthun gyi klan ka gnyis kyi mtshan gzhi rim bzhin/ byang 'phags chos can/ lam gsum sgom pa med par thal/ nyan rang gi lam sgom pa med pa'i phyir zhes dang / don dam par bsgom bya rang spyi'i mtshan nyid yod par thal/ kun rdzob tu yum sgom pa yod pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /phyi ma la don dam rigs mthun dang / rigs mi mthun gyi klan ka gnyis kyi mtshan gzhi rim bzhin/ don dam par bar chad med rtse'i dmigs pa mi 'thad par thal/ don dam par 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi khams med pa'i phyir zhes dang /

kun rdzob tu yum sgom pa mi 'thad par thal/ don dam par bsgom bya rang spyi'i mtshan nyid mi 'thad pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu'o/ /kun rdzob tu bar chad med rtse'i dmigs pa mi 'thad par thal/ don dam par 'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas kyi khams med pa'i phyir/ zhes gzhung las dngos su bstan pa'i klan ka bcu drug ni don dam rigs mi mthun gyi klan ka dang / don dam par 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi khams yod par thal/ kun rdzob tu bar chad med rtse'i dmigs pa 'thad pa'i phyir/ zhes pa lta bu gzhung las shugs bstan gyi klan ka bcu drug ni kun rdzob rigs mi mthun gyi klan ka yin no/ /gnyis pa sel byed la log rtog sel byed kyi shes rab dang / klan ka sel byed kyi lan gnyis/ dang po la kun rdzob tu yod kyang don dam par med pa rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis kun rdzob rgyu mtshan du byas nas don dam par mi 'thad do snyam pa'i log rtog sel/ don dam du med kyang kun rdzob tu yod pa mi 'gal bar rtogs pa'i shes rab kyis don dam rgyu mtshan du byas nas kun rdzob kyi rnam gzhag mi 'thad do snyam pa'i log rtog sel lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ gzhung las dngos bstan gyi don dam sgo can gyi klan ka bcu drug la kun rdzob kyi sgo nas lan 'debs shing / shugs bstan kun rdzob sgo can gyi klan ka bcu drug la don dam gyi sgo nas 'debs dgos pa yin gyi/ spyir don dam sgo can gyi klan ka la kun rdzob dang / kun rdzob sgo can gyi klan ka la don dam gyi sgo nas lan 'debs dgos pa ni ma nges te/ don dam sgo can gyi klan ka yin na kun rdzob sun 'byin pa dang / kun rdzob sgo can gyi klan ka yin na don dam sun 'byin pas ma khyab pa'i phyir/ des na skabs 'dir bstan gyi bsal bya log rtog gi mtshan nyid/ dmigs pa 'thad pa la sogs pa'i yul bcu drug po gang rung la bden gnyis gang rung rgyu mtshan du byas nas bden gnyis gang rung mi 'thad snyam du 'dzin pa'i log rtog

skabs 'dir bstan gyi bsal bya klan ka'i mtshan nyid/ dmigs pa 'thad pa la sogs pa'i yul bcu drug po gang rung la bden gnyis gang rung rgyu mtshan du byas nas sun 'byin par byed pa'i sun 'byin ltar snang / dbye na skabs 'dir bstan gyi don dam sgo can gyi klan ka dang / kun rdzob sgo can gyi klan ka gnyis/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ gzhan 'dra ba la/ don dam rgyu mtshan du byas nas zhes pa dang / kun rdzob rgyu mtshan du byas nas zhes sbyar/ skabs 'dir bstan gyi sel byed gnyen po'i mtshan nyid/ bden gnyis kyi gnas lugs phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i blo'i rgyun shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /sbas don rab gsal las skabs lnga pa'i mtshon byed kyi chos rnams kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o// //drug pa mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang rgyu sbyor lam rtse sbyor las byung zhing brtan pa thob ba'i ched du mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa go rim du sgom par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ gnyis pa la sbyor ba phun tshogs phar phyin drug gi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ bsam pa phun tshogs rjes dran drug gi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba/ dngos med ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba dang gsum las/ dang po la sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba sogs drug dang po'i mtshan nyid/ sbyin pa'i phar phyin gyi nyams len gyis zin pa'i sgo nas brtan pa thob pa'i ched du mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa go rim du sgom par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ des phyi ma lnga la yang 'gre'o/ /gnyis pa la sangs rgyas/ chos/ dge 'dun/ tshul khrims/ gtong ba/ lha rjes su dran pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba ste drug mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ dran pa nyer gzhag sogs kyi lam gsum don dam par dran pa med cing kun rdzob tu mtshan nyid rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas dang /

dge mi dge lung ma bstan gyi chos don dam par sogs dang / byang sems 'phags pa don dam par sogs dang / tshul khrims gsum don dam par sogs dang / gtong ba gsum don dam par sogs dang / lhar skyes pa'i 'phags pa don dam par dran pa med cing / kun rdzob tu mtshan nyid rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas brtan pa thob pa'i ched du mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa go rim du sgom par byed pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor/ gsum pa dngos med ngo bo nyid du rtogs pa'i mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba'i mtshan nyid/ chos thams cad bden pa'i ngo bo nyid du med par rtogs pa'i sgo nas brtan pa thob pa'i ched du sogs so/ /gsum pa ni/ 'phags pa ltar na theg chen gyi tshogs lam na yod cing / slob dpon ltar na theg chen gyi drod skad cig gnyis pa nas rgyun mtha'i snga logs kyi bar na yod do/ /sbas don rab gsal las skabs drug pa'i mtshon byed kyi chos rnams kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o// //bdun pa skad cig ma'i sbyor ba la/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba/ sa mtshams dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ brtan pa thob nas mkhyen gsum gyi rnam pa rnams dus skad cig ma gcig la cig car du sgom pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug go /gnyis pa la rnam par smin pa min pa'i/ rnam par smin pa'i/ mtshan nyid med pa'i/ gnyis su med pa'i skad cig ma'i sbyor ba dang bzhi las/ dang po la mtshan nyid dngos dang / rnam smin yin min ngos gzung ba/ mngon du byed pa'i dpe dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rnam par smin pa min pa'i zag med kyi rtogs rigs gcig mngon du byed pa'i tshe de dang rigs mthun pa'i zag med kyi chos thams cad mngon du byed nus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug go /gnyis pa ni/ rgyun mtha'i gnas skabs kyi sa bdun pa man chad kyi zag med kyi rtogs rigs la rnam par smin pa min pa'i zag med kyi rtogs rigs zhes bya ste/
