sa bdun pa man chad kyi zag med kyi ye shes de 'bad rtsol dang bcas pas rnam par smin pa min par bzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /rgyun mtha'i gnas skabs kyi sa brgyad pa yan chad kyi rtogs rigs la rnam par smin pa'i zag med kyi rtogs rigs zhes bya ste/ sa brgyad pa yan chad kyi yon tan de 'bad rtsol la mi ltos pas rnam par smin par gzhag pa'i phyir ro/ /'dir rnam par smin pa min pa'i zag med kyi yon tan dang / de'i rtogs rigs ma nor ba gal che ste/ sa brgyad pa yan chad kyi zag med gyi yon tan yin na rnam par smin pa min pa'i zag med kyi yon tan min pas khyab kyang / de'i rtogs rigs min pas ma khyab pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ zag med kyi rtogs rigs gcig mngon du byas na de dang rigs mthun pa'i rtogs rigs thams cad mngon du byed pa'i dpe ni/ skyes bu'i rdog stabs gcig gis bskyod pa na zo chun gyi rgyud cig car 'gul ba bzhin no/ /phyi ma gsum gyi mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ rnam par smin pa'i zag med kyi rtogs rigs gcig mngon du byas pa na de dang rigs mthun pa'i zag med kyi rtogs rigs thams cad mngon du byed nus pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug dang / chos thams cad bden pa'i mtshan nyid med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug chos thams cad gzung 'dzin gnyis su med par mngon sum du rtogs pa'i sems dpa'i rnal 'byor mthar thug go /gsum pa ni/ rgyun mtha'i ye shes gcig la yon tan mngon du byed tshul gyi sgo nas dang po gnyis dang / chos nyid rtogs tshul gyi sgo nas phyi ma gnyis phye ba yin pas bzhi ka yang rgyun mtha' kho nar yod do/ /sbas don rab gsal las skabs bdun pa'i mtshon byed kyi chos rnams kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o// //brgyad pa 'bras bu chos sku la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/

sbyor bzhi bsgoms pa'i rnam smin mthar thug go /gnyis pa la 'phags pas rtsa ba'i dgongs pa 'chad pa'i tshul dang / slob dpon gyis rgan po'i zer sgros 'chad pa'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po la ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye na rten sku dang / brten pa phrin las gnyis so/ /mtshon byed chos kyi sgo nas dbye na ngo bo nyid sku/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku/ sprul pa'i sku/ mdzad pa phrin las dang bzhi'o/ /dang po la mtshan nyid dang / zag med kyi yon tan bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni dag pa gnyis ldan gyi dbyings mthar thug dang zag med kyi yon tan dbyer med du gyur pa'i rang don don dam pa'i sku'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ 'o na mtshan nyid gsum ldan du gyur pa'i zag med kyi ye shes de gang zhe na/ 'di la ye shes kyi rang bzhin/ yon tan gyi khyad par/ de la rtsod pa spong ba dang gsum las/ dang po la sde tshan nyer gcig las/ dang po byang chub phyogs mthun dang / gnyis pa tshad med bzhi dang / gsum pa rnam thar brgyad dang / bzhi pa mthar gnas kyi snyoms 'jug dgu ni rang rang gi ngo bo skabs dang po dang / skabs bzhi par bshad zin cing / 'dir sangs rgyas kyi sa la sbyor ba'i tshe gnas yongs su gyur pa'i ye shes mthar thug ces sbyor/ lnga pa zad par la/ mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas gang gi sgo nas zad par du 'jog pa'i dmigs pa'i snang ba des rang yul gyi shes bya thams cad la khyab par spro nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni zad par gyi ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan nyid yin la/ zad par gyi skye mched gyi mtshan nyid du 'jog na de ltar nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa zhes sbyar ro/ /gnyis pa la zad par sa dang / chu dang / me dang / rlung dang / sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / nam mkha' dang / rnam par shes pa'i skye mched de bcu'o/

/mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas dmigs pa'i snang ba sa nas rnam par shes pa'i bar rang yul gyi shes bya thams cad la khyab par spro nus pa'i ting nge 'dzin shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa zhes so sor sbyar ro/ /mdzod ltar na/ dang po brgyad la/ de ltar spro nus pa'i sems byung ma chags pa'i rang bzhin zhes pa dang / phyi ma gnyis la bdag rkyen gzugs med kyi dngos gzhi la brten nas zhes sbyar ro/ /drug pa zil gnon la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas rang yul gyi gzugs thams cad ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du dbang bsgyur ba'i sgo nas zil gyis gnon par nus pa'i zhi lhag zung 'jug go /gnyis pa la brgyad yod pa las/ gzugs can gzugs chung ngu la lta ba'i zil gnon gyi mtshan nyid/ bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten nas rang la gzugs snang ma dor ba'i sgo nas rang yul du gyur pa'i sems can gzugs bzang ngan thams cad la 'dod pa bzhin du dbang bsgyur ba'i sgo nas zil gyis gnon nus pa'i zhi lhag zung 'jug go /gzugs can gzugs chen po la lta ba'i zil gnon gyi mtshan nyid/ gzhan 'dra ba las rang yul du gyur pa'i snod kyi gzugs bzang ngan thams cad zhes sogs sbyar ro/ /gzugs med gzugs chung ngu dang / chen po dang / sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po la lta ba'i zil gnon rnams kyi mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ bdag rkyen bsam gtan gyi dngos gzhi'i sems la brten te rang la gzugs snang dor ba'i sgo nas sems can dang / snod kyi gzugs bzang ngan thams cad dang / phyi rol gyi gzugs sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po rnams ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du dbang bsgyur ba'i sgo nas zil gyis gnon nus pa'i zhi lhag zung 'jug go /bdun pa nyon mongs med pa la mtshan nyid dang /

dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gzhan rgyud kyi nyon mongs 'gog pas khyad par du byas pa'i sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa la nyan thos/ rang rgyal/ sangs rgyas kyi nyon mongs pa med pa dang gsum las/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ gzhan rgyud kyi nyon mongs skye rung re zhig 'gog pas khyad par du byas pa'i nyan thos kyi rgyud kyi dang / rang rgyal gyi rgyud kyi sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa dang / gzhan rgyud kyi nyon mongs drung nas 'byin pa'i ched du chos ston pa'i bdag rkyen du gyur pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud kyi sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /brgyad pa smon gnas shes pa la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nyon mongs med pa'i sngon du gzhan rgyud kyi nyon mongs skye mi skye mngon sum rtogs pas khyad par du byas pa'i sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa la nyan thos dang / rang rgyal gyi smon gnas shes pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi smon gnas mkhyen pa gsum las/ dang po gnyis kyi mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ rtsa ba'i mtshan nyid gzhir bzhag nas nyan thos kyi rgyud kyi dang / rang rgyal gyi rgyud kyi sems rtse gcig pa zhes sbyar ro/ /gsum pa'i mtshan nyid/ 'khor ba ji srid pa dang / rnam par grol ba ji srid par 'jug pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rgyud kyi sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /dgu pa mngon par shes pa drug dang / bcu pa so so yang dag rig pa bzhi ni bshad zin to/ /bcu gcig pa yongs su dag pa la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rten yongs dag sogs la dbang bsgyur ba'i rang gzhan gyi don sgrub pa'i sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa/ gnyis pa la bzhi las/ rten yongs su dag pa ni lus 'dor len la dbang byed pa'o/ dmigs pa yongs su dag pa ni sprul bsgyur la dbang byed pa'o/

/thugs yongs su dag pa ni ting nge 'dzin grangs med la dbang byed pa'o/ /ye shes yongs su dag pa ni gzungs kyi sgo dpag tu med pa la dbang byed pa'o/ /bcu gnyis pa dbang la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ phar phyin drug gi 'bras bu mthar thug grub pas rang gi bsgyur bya la dbang sgyur ba'i sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /dbye na bcu las/ tshe la dbang ba ni bskal pa'am bskal pa las lhag par bzhugs pa'i nus pa thob pa'o/ /sems la dbang ba ni ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du snyoms par 'jug pa'i nus pa thob pa'o/ /yo byad la dbang ba ni nor gyi char 'bebs nus pa'o/ /las la dbang ba ni gong mar myong gyur gyi rnam par smin pa 'dod par sgyur nus pa'o/ /skye ba la dbang ba ni bsam gtan las ma nyams bzhin du 'dod par skye ba len par byed pa'o/ /mos pa la dbang ba ni sa dang chu la sogs pa gang mos pa de dang der 'gyur ba'o/ /smon lam la dbang ba ni gzhan don phun sum tshogs par byed pa'i smon lam grangs med pa 'grub pa'o/ /rdzu 'phrul la dbang ba ni gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir rdzu 'phrul dpag tu med pa ston pa'o/ /ye shes la dbang ba ni so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi phul du byung ba'i mthar 'gro ba'o/ /chos la dbang ba ni gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas gdul bya'i bsam pa ji lta ba bzhin du chos ston par mdzad pa'o/ /'di dag las dang po gsum ni sbyin pa gsum gyi 'bras bu'o/ /las dang skye ba gnyis ni tshul khrims dang / mos pa ni bzod pa dang / smon lam ni brtson 'grus dang / rdzu 'phrul ni bsam gtan dang / tha ma gnyis ni shes rab kyi 'bras bu'o/ /bcu gsum pa stobs bcu dang / bcu bzhi pa mi 'jigs pa bzhi ni bshad zin to/ /bco lnga pa bsrung ba med pa la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang gi spyod pa la gzhan gyis yongs su shes pa'i bsnyengs pas bcab par bya'o snyam pa'i dgongs pa mi mnga' ba'i sems rtse gcig pa mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/

/gnyis pa la/ sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi spyod pa bsrung ba med pa gsum/ mtshan nyid rim bzhin/ sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi spyod pa la gzhan gyis yongs su shes pa zhes sogs sbyar ro/ /bcu drug pa dran pa nyer gzhag la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ chos nyan pa'i gdul bya la chags sdang gis dben pa kho nar btang snyoms su dran pa dang ldan par gnas pa'i dran pa shes rab mtshungs ldan dang bcas pa'o/ /gnyis pa la chos gus par nyan pa'i gdul bya la 'dod chags kyis dben pa dang / gus pas mi nyan pa'i gdul bya la khong khros dben pa dang / phyogs gcig gus pas nyan pa dang mi nyan pa la chags sdang gnyis kas dben pa'i dran pa nyer gzhag gsum mo/ /bcu bdun pa bsnyel ba mi mnga' ba'i chos nyid kyi mtshan nyid/ sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i dus las skad cig kyang mi 'da' ba'i mthar thug gi ye shes so/ /bco brgyad pa bag chags yang dag bcom pa'i mtshan nyid/ sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa ma lus par spangs pa'i ye shes mthar thug go /bcu dgu pa thugs rje chen po'i mtshan nyid/ skye bo mtha' dag la phan par sems pa'i ye shes mthar thug go /nyi shu pa ma 'dres pa bco brgyad dang / nyer gcig pa rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni bshad zin to/ /dang zhes pa'i sgras slob dpon gyis lam shes dang / gzhi shes bsdus par 'dod kyang / 'phags pas 'byed pa la 'dod kyi sdud pa la mi 'dod/ gang las 'byed na/ chos kyi sku zhes brjod pa yin/ /zhes pa'i chos sku las 'byed de/ 'di'i chos sku ni chos nyid kyi sku la sdeb sbyor gyi dbang gis nyid kyi rkyen ta mi mngon par byas nas/ chos kyi sku zhes gzhag pa yin pas don chos nyid kyi sku yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gang 'byed na byang chub phyogs mthun nas rnam mkhyen gyi bar nyer gcig po de'o/ /ji ltar 'byed na sde tshan nyer gcig po de zag pa med pa'i chos gang dag

'thob 'gyur zhes pa'i zag med kyi chos kyi mtshan gzhi yin gyi/ chos sku'i mtshan gzhi min te/ chos nyid kyi sku min pa'i phyir zhes pa'i tshul gyis so/ /gnyis pa yon tan gyi khyad par la/ nyon mongs med pa'i dang / smon pa med pa'i khyad par gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sangs rgyas kyi nyon mongs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin nyan thos la sogs pa'i ting nge 'dzin las khyad par du 'phags te/ grong la sogs par byon nas skye bo mtha' dag gi nyon mongs pa drung nas 'byin pa'i ched du chos ston pa'i bdag rkyen byed pa'i mkhyen pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi smon gnas mkhyen pa ni nyan thos la sogs pa'i smon gnas shes pa las khyad par du 'phags te/ mtshan ma med par lhun gyis grub pa sogs khyad chos lnga dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gsum pa rtsod pa spang ba ni/ rtag gnas dang zhes pa las 'phros nas chos sku rtag tu gnas na rtag tu sems can thams cad kyi don ci'i phyir mi mdzad ce na skyon med de/ chos skus sems can gyi don mdzad par khyad par med kyang / sangs rgyas su snang ba'i smon lam dang dge rtsa smin pa'i sems can la sangs rgyas su snang la de ma smin pa la de mi snang ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa longs sku la mtshan nyid dang / yon tan rgyas par bshad pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ nges pa lnga ldan gyi gzugs sku mthar thug nges pa lnga ni/ gnas nges pa 'og min kho na dang / dus nges pa 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du sku'i snang ba mi sdud par bzhugs pa/ ngo bo nges pa mtshan dpes spras pa/ 'khor nges pa byang sems 'phags pa kho nas bskor ba/ chos nges pa theg chen gyi chos 'ba' zhig la longs spyod pa dang lnga las/ rtsa bar ngo bo dang chos gnyis dngos su 'byung zhing / 'grel par 'khor dang gsum gsungs so/ /gnyis pa la mtshan dang / dpe byad gnyis las/ longs sku'i mtshan gyi mtshan nyid/ longs sku gzhan ngor skyes bu dam par mtshon par byed pa'i yon tan/

dbye na/ phyag dang zhabs 'khor lo'i mtshan dang ldan pa sogs so gnyis dang / de'i rgyu la yang bla ma rnams la skyel ba dang bsu ba sogs so gnyis yod do/ /longs sku'i dpe byad kyi mtshan nyid/ longs sku mthong ba tsam gyis rab tu dad par byed pa'i yon tan/ dbye na/ sen mo'i dbang du byas pa/ sor mo'i dbang du byas pa/ rtsa'i dbang du byas pa/ zhabs kyi dbang du byas pa/ gshegs tshul gyi dbang du byas pa/ sku'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbang du byas pa/ phyag gi dbang du byas pa/ zhal 'khor bcas kyi dbang du byas pa/ dbu dbu skra dang bcas pa'i dbang du byas pa ste sde tshan dgu las/ dang po la sen mo zangs kyi mdog ltar dmar ba sogs gsum/ gnyis pa la sor mo zlum pa sogs gsum/ gsum pa la rtsa mi mngon pa sogs gnyis/ bzhi pa la long bu mi mngon pa sogs gnyis/ lnga pa la seng ge'i stabs su gshegs pa sogs bdun/ drug pa la 'khril bag chags pa sogs nyer lnga/ bdun pa la phyag shing bal ltar 'jam pa sogs bzhi/ brgyad pa la zhal mchu dang bcas pa'i dbang du byas pa/ ljags gsung dang bcas pa'i dbang du byas pa/ mche ba'i dbang du byas pa/ shangs kyi dbang du byas pa/ spyan 'khor dang bcas pa'i dbang du byas pa/ snyan gyi dbang du byas pa/ dpral ba'i dbang du byas pa ste bdun las/ dang po la zhal ha cang mi ring ba sogs gnyis/ gnyis pa la ljags mnyen pa sogs drug gsum pa la mche ba zlum pa sogs lnga/ bzhi pa la shangs mtho ba sogs gnyis/ lnga pa la spyan yangs pa sogs bdun/ drug pa la snyan ring zhing rgyas pa sogs gsum/ bdun pa la dpral ba legs par phyes pa sogs gnyis/ rtsa ba'i dgu pa la dbu rgyas pa sogs brgyad do/ /gsum pa la sprul sku la mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sems can gyi don du gang la gang 'dul gyi skur ston pa'i longs sku'i sprul pa'o/ /gnyis pa la/ rgyan las/ bzo dang skye dang byang chub che/ /zhes pa ltar gsum las/

bzo'i sprul sku ni dri za'i rgyal po rab dga' 'dul ba'i ched du pi wang mkhan gyi gzugs su sprul pa lta bu'o/ /skye ba'i sprul sku ni gdul bya'i don du ri bong du skye ba gzung ba lta bu'o/ /mchog gi sprul sku ni mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi tshul dngos su ston pa ste shākya thub pa lta bu'o/ /gnyis pa brten pa phrin las la chos sku'i phrin las kyi mtshan nyid dang / dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po ni chos skus bdag rkyen byas pa las byung ba'i rnam dkar gyi yon tan no/ /gnyis pa la rten gyi sgo nas dang / sa mtshams kyi sgo nas dbye ba gnyis las/ dang po la byed pa po la yod pa'i phrin las dang / bya ba yul la yod pa'i phrin las gnyis las/ dang po ni sangs rgyas kyi sa kho nar yod de/ sangs rgyas 'phags pa'i rgyud kyi rnam mkhyen la gdul bya lam gyi rten la 'god pa nas mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la 'god pa'i bar gyi byed las nyi shu rtsa bdun dang ldan pa rnams so/ /gnyis pa la gdul bya lam gyi rten la bkod pa nas mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la bkod pa'i bar nyi shu rtsa bdun yod do/ /sangs rgyas phyi ma'i rgyud kyi mi gnas pa'i myang 'das de yang sangs rgyas snga ma la ltos te/ bya ba yul la yod pa'i phrin las su 'gyur ro/ /gnyis pa la gdul bya lam gyi rten la 'god pa/ lam la 'god pa/ lam gyi 'bras bu la 'god pa dang gsum las/ dang po 'khor ba mtha' dag spangs nas myang 'das thob 'dod kyi blo la 'god pa'o/ /gnyis pa la tshogs lam/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam la 'god pa dang bzhi las/ dang po la bsdu dngos bzhi la 'god pa dang / blang dor rtogs pa dang / gzhan don gyi spyod pa dang / rang don gyi spyod pa dang / gnyis don gyi spyod pa la 'god pa ste lnga'o/ /gnyis pa ni stong nyid goms pa la 'god pa'o/ /gsum pa ni sbyin pa'i phar phyin la 'god pa'o/ /bzhi pa la sa gnyis pa nas lnga pa'i bar la 'god pa dang /

drug pa/ bdun pa/ brgyad pa/ dgu pa/ bcu pa la 'god pa dang drug las/ dang po ni tshul khrims kyi phar phyin nas bsam gtan gyi phar phyin gyi bar la 'god pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni shes rab kyi phar phyin la 'god pa'o/ /gsum pa ni thabs kyi phar phyin la 'god pa'o/ /bzhi pa la stobs kyi phar phyin stobs kyis byang chub sems dpa'i lam dang / mngon par zhen pa bzlog pa la 'god pa gnyis so/ /lnga pa ni smon lam gyi phar phyin la 'god pa'o/ /drug pa la sa bcu thob ma thag pa la 'god pa gcig skye ba gcig gis thogs pa la 'god pa gsum/ srid pa tha ma la 'god pa brgyad rnams so/ /gsum pa lam gyi 'bras bu la 'god pa ni mi gnas pa'i myang 'das la 'god pa'o/ /de ltar phrin las nyer bdun po re re la yang byed pa po la yod pa dang / bya ba yul la yod pa gnyis gnyis su phye ba ni skabs kyi don te sngar bshad zin to/ /gnyis pa slob dpon gyis rgan po'i zer sgros 'chad tshul ni/ byang chub phyogs mthun tshad med dang / /zhes sogs kyis ye shes chos sku bstan pas sangs rgyas kyi sku la bzhir grangs nges shing / lus rnam gzhag tu chos sku mjug tu smos pa ni tshigs bcad sbyar bde ba dang / mdzad pa thams cad ye shes chos sku kho na'i mdzad par gtogs pa'i ched yin zhes sogs spros pa dang bcas te 'chad pa la dpyad pa gzhan du bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa bar pa la dad pa la drug tu bstan pa ni/ mtshan nyid dang / sbyor ba dang / rab dang / go rim dang / mthar thug pa dang / rnam smin te drug las/ dang po ni mkhyen pa gsum ste/ 'phags pas mtshan nyid pa'i shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no zhes dang / slob dpon gyis mngon par mtshon pa'i gnas nyid yin pas mtshan nyid do zhes gsungs so/ /phyi ma lnga sbyor ba bzhi dang / 'bras bu chos sku'o/ /gsum pa bsdus pa la dad pa la gsum du bsdu ba ni/ slob dpon ltar na yul gyi rgyu dang /

sbyor ba dang / 'bras bu gsum/ 'phags pa dang / sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs ltar na yul dang / rgyu dang / 'bras bu dang gsum las/ dang po ni mkhyen pa gsum mo/ /gnyis pa ni sbyor ba bzhi'o/ /gsum pa ni chos kyi sku mdzad pa dang bcas pa'o// //gang gi legs gsung 'od zer stong ldan gyis/ /lhan skyes yid kyi mun pa kun bsal nas/ /yum don pad tshal rgyas pa'i gnyen gcig po/ /rong ston dam pa'i nyi mas da dung skyongs/ /gang zhig gsung la brten nas gang zhig gis/ /gang zhig ches bsags dge rtsa gang zhig ni/ /gang zhig rjes 'brang gdul bya gang zhig gis/ /gang zhig rtogs nas gang zhig thob phyir bsngo/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i mtshon byed kyi chos rnams kyi yan lag rgyas par bshad pa sbas don rab gsal zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rong ston pa dam pa sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa ji lta ba bzhin du/ mang du thos pa'i dge slong bsod nams seng ges/ chu pho 'brug gi lo sa ga zla ba'i yar tshes gsum la/ rta nag gser gling gi dgon par sbyar ba'i/ yi ge pa ni snyom las pa gzhon nu bzang po'o// //'di bsgrubs pa las byung ba yi/ /dge ba gang dang gang thob pa/ /des ni skye bo thams cad kyis/ /bde gshegs shes rab myur thob shog /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal sman gcig pu/ /bde ba thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas/ /bstan pa rnyed dang bkur sti dang / /bcas te yun ring gnas gyur cig /dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun mkhyen go bo rab 'byams pa/ sbas don rab gsal la/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
